data.jd_text:
Emirates Hills
   

  

 Junior Project Planner / PMO
   

  

 Join our PMO as a Junior Project Planner. If you’re early in your planning career, highly organised and data\-driven, this role grows with you on design\-led projects.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Junior Project Planner / PMO Coordinator to support our PMO and Project Management team across multiple design\-led and fit\-out projects.
   

  

 This role is suited to someone early in their planning or PMO career who is highly organised, numerate, and systems\-driven, with hands\-on exposure to project programmes, reporting, and cost tracking.
   

  

 You will support Project Managers and the PMO, ensuring that programmes, budgets, and reporting are kept accurate, up to date, and aligned with agreed project plans.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Planning \& Scheduling:**
* Support the development and maintenance of project programmes using MS Project
* Update schedules with progress from Project Managers, consultants, and contractors


**Track Key Milestones Across**
* Design stages
* Authority approvals
* Procurement
* Fit\-out and handover
* Assist with identifying programme risks and slippage
* PMO Reporting \& Controls
* Prepare weekly and monthly project reports for the PMO


**Maintain**
* Programme trackers
* Risk and issue logs
* Action registers
* Ensure reporting data is accurate, structured, and submitted on time
* Support PMO governance and internal review.


**Cost \& Budget Tracking**
* Maintain Smart Sheets / MS Projects /Excel\-based cost trackers against approved budgets
* Track consultant fees, variations, and forecast vs actual spend
* Support cash\-flow tracking and basic cost reporting
* Flag inconsistencies or potential overruns to the PMO / Project Manager


**Design \& Fit\-Out Coordination Support**
* Track design deliverables, review cycles, and approvals
* Support coordination between designers, consultants, and project teams
* Ensure design timelines align with procurement and construction activities


**Systems \& Documentation**
* Maintain structured project folders and documentation
* Support data entry and updates within PMO systems
* Assist in improving PMO templates and reporting formats


**Essential**
**Candidate Requirements:**
* 2\-4 years’ experience in a project planning, PMO, or project coordination role
* Proficiency in MS Project and Smartsheet
* Strong Excel skills (mandatory) – including trackers, formulas, and basic cost reporting
* Exposure to fit\-out / interior projects (even if limited)
* Experience supporting Project Managers, planners, or PMO teams
* High attention to detail with strong organisational and reporting skills
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Willingness to grow into a senior PMO or planning role


**Nice To Have (Not Essential)**
* PMI\-SP (Scheduling Professional)
* Exposure to cost control or commercial tracking (RICS\-aligned experience, even without chartership)
* Lean or Agile exposure where applied pragmatically (not theoretical only)
* Experience in hospitality, F\&B, retail, or design\-led fit\-out projects
* Familiarity with UAE approval processes

**About this Position** 
 Are you energized by solving complex project challenges within Operations \& Supply Chain? Do you enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity while staying agile and impact\-driven? As the Regional PMO \& Strategy Manager for the Operations \& Supply Chain team of Adhesive Technologies, you will play a key role in strengthening project excellence across the IMEA (India, Middle East, and Africa) region. This dynamic role combines capital project governance, strategic project support, cross\-functional collaboration, and capability building. You will partner closely with project teams, functional leads, and senior executives to ensure that capital initiatives are well\-planned, well\-governed, and aligned with strategic priorities. This role is ideal for someone with a structured and analytical mindset, strong communication skills, and a proactive, can\-do attitude.
   

  

**What You´ll Do**
* Lead and deliver strategic projects at regional and global levels, driving business impact and alignment
* Translate complex data into actionable insights and influence decision\-making through executive\-level presentations
* Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration through improved processes, governance, and communication frameworks
* Manage the capital project portfolio, including resource allocation, prioritization, and performance tracking
* Lead capital projects through initiation and feasibility phases, ensuring strong structure and team setup
* Drive continuous improvement through project audits, lessons learned, and implementation of best practices
* Identify capability gaps and deliver targeted training and coaching to enhance project management excellence
* Provide agile, hands\-on project support and promote a culture of continuous improvement across the organization


**What makes you a good fit**
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in strategy, project management, or related fields
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, or related disciplines) preferred
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree required
* Experience in chemical or process industries is an advantage
* Proven experience in strategy teams, strategy consulting, or strategic roles is highly valued
* Prior exposure to operations, supply chain, LEAN methodologies, robotics, or automation is a plus
* Proficiency in Power BI, SharePoint, Microsoft Office Suite, and Copilot tools is preferred


 At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We look for a diverse team of individuals who possess different backgrounds, experiences, personalities and mindsets.

**Title And Summary**
 Technical Program Management Analyst I, Launch Graduate Program 2026 \- Dubai, United Arab Emirates
   

  

 Technical Program Management Analyst I, Launch Graduate Program 2026 \- Dubai, United Arab Emirates (UAE Nationals preferred)
   

  

**Launch Program**
 Mastercard Launch is an 18\-month global development program providing recent graduates with opportunities and exposure. You will not only enhance your professional growth and skills in a global setting, you’ll launch your Mastercard career.
   

  

**Technical Program Management Analyst I**
 As a Technical Program Management Analyst, you will Work across teams to:

* Proactively manage all dependencies, ensuring all outputs are production ready at launch.


**What you’ll need**
* To be available to start from 1st September 2026
* To be a Final Year Undergraduate/Masters students or to have graduated no earlier than September 2025
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong strategic and conceptual aptitude
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritise multiple projects concurrently
* High\-energy, can\-do attitude, very strong sense of ownership


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 To Direct, oversee and manage the delivery of construction projects (buildings and fit outs projects) of the group (new/ existing), ensuring completion of projects within the agreed specification/ quality standards, budgets and timelines.
 



  





**Essential Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Provides leadership and strategic guidance, and supporting the development of business strategies to deliver the required levels of productivity
* Contribute to the development of Project Management Department Strategy, in conjunction with Director, ensuring alignment to the objectives and strategy of the organization.
* Participate in the development, review and reporting of the policies and procedures framework (Audit, Document Control, Financial and Accounting, Design Compliance and Corporate Identity, QC, HSE) that allow the function to effectively meet its objectives and targets, in line with Project Management department policies and procedures in line with Group’s strategy and direction.
* Puts resource strategies in place and manages resource costs to overhead budgets.
* Review and report to Director on strategic decisions during the entire lifecycle of the projects.
* Contribute strategic support the group legal department in case of any necessity in terms of claim and disputes with consultants and contractors.
* Provide guidance to other internal business units and departments in terms of budget, timing and strategy throughout the project execution stage
* In conjunction with the other business units, develop a business plan setting out the strategies which will deliver the organizations longer\-term goals.
* Manage the design and project execution of projects with Al Tayer Real Estate, Al Tayer Motor and private projects getting developed by directors, by contracting external designers/consultants/contractors, finalize the same for implementation and ensure that the agreed design and project milestone deliverables are met in accordance with the project program.
* Implement approved procedures for tendering, selection and appointment of contractors, payment terms, dealings and communications between all parties in coordination with group legal functions.
* Implement internal processes and manage, to ensure that all contracts / agreements with contractors, suppliers and consultants are agreed, finalized and signed off before commencement of work, to avoid any legal dispute/claims etc. post execution.
* Oversee the development of project schedules, which include key project milestones and critical paths to ensure adherence and take corrective action as appropriate and work in consolidation with Operations, Business Units, and developer to accomplish its objectives within the constraints of time, quality and agreed cost.
* Liaise with Business units to understand the requirements and specifications of new projects and maintain an awareness of principle requirements in the design of the projects, ensuring they are considered in the execution stage.
* Review designs, recommend ideas/concepts to ensure that layouts effectively maximize functionality and aesthetic expectations of the projects by ensuring HSE compliance as per approved group policies.
* Oversee the Review and approve the drawings submitted by contractors and ensure that they are examined by all parties concerned.
* Manage the tender process effectively to ensure that all contractors, vendors, consultants selected are most capable of carrying out project requirements.
* Ensures that there are effective contract and documentation procedures in place to deliver legally complaint projects and minimize costs and risks.
* Ensure that CAPEX for all new projects are submitted to the business in a timely manner for review and approval.
* Monitors contractors’ work for compliance with schedule, budget, quality, safety, and overall conformance with the contract documents
* Owns the Health and Safety policy for Construction and puts processes and systems in place to monitor its compliance and share best practice.
* Oversee the changes process during project life cycle, which includes identifying, documenting, and controlling changes to the scope baseline, are validated and mechanism for the project management team to consistently communicate and seek approval of all changes from the stakeholders through set policies of using change control forms etc, is being adhered to.
* Identify possible risks for all upcoming and ongoing projects, ensure proactive risk plans to manage and mitigate risks and engage in a proactive communication strategy with clients and stakeholders. Puts in place effective risk management processes to identify, quantify, monitor and minimize risks in projects.
* Resolves field construction problems in coordination with engineering staff, third parties, and other agencies as necessary.
* Maintain updated projects matrix for current and upcoming projects based on agreed project master plan. Conduct quarterly audits on projects processes to ensure compliance and adherence to agreed policies and procedures.
* Identify opportunities to make use of external contractors and subcontractors, establish and maintain relationship with trusted organizations that meet the group requirements.
* Oversee the development of vendor and supplier list in database for the supply of right products for the projects.
* Oversee snagging and handover of projects by consultant and contractor to ensure the overall readiness of the project for commencement of business operations.
* To oversee the co\-ordination of the communication strategy within the project to ensure all stakeholders and interested concerned parties receive the information they want at the appropriate time.
* Establish a culture / process of value engineering within project team and look for more cost\-effective methods to achieve the same.
* Maintain an awareness of legislative and regulatory requirements and ensure conformance to all quality, health and safety regulations.
* Ensure effective and proper contract governance is implemented prior to project completion.
* Provide the director with advice and expertise on critical issues regarding the project, and implementation
* Liaises with the Finance Director to track the financial performance of Construction and ensures that Finance receive accurate information in a timely and organized manner
* Follow up and monitor the external governmental rules and regulations to ensure newly developing rules and regulations are well captured and implemented in projects
* Sets a culture of continuous improvement including the setup of processes and committees to learn and share best practice.
* Provide Leadership and direction to subordinate towards the achievement of goals and objectives.
* Guide and motivate subordinates to enhance performance and produce quality work, and ensure that they are continuously developed for higher level roles.
* Set targets, objectives and clear responsibilities for all supervised staff, progressively monitor individual performance against the agreed criteria and conduct formal appraisals in keeping with time frames
* Prepare performance evaluation and appraisal reports of direct reports to assess subordinates productivity and progress and identify training needs of team members to improve efficiency and ensure conformity with standard procedures and practices
* Provides mentoring support to direct team and other colleagues across the business in line with the succession plans



  





**Education, Skills and Experiences** 



* Degree in Civil Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification relevant to Construction Project Management.
* 15 years of experience in construction field

**Job Summary**
 At Zurich Middle East, we’re committed to shaping a brighter future together. As part of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s largest and most experienced insurers, our mission is to help communities understand and protect themselves from risk—locally and globally.
   

  

 Are you ready to drive transformation and help Zurich create brighter outcomes for everyone? Join our team and bring your passion for excellence to Zurich Middle East, delivering impactful results for clients, colleagues, and communities.
   

  

 As an interim Operational Excellence Lead, you will drive operational and process improvement, supporting the Head of Operations and the wider Operations management team. By leading transformation initiatives and embedding robust governance, you will accelerate automation and deliver consistent, data\-driven operational excellence that benefits both customers and colleagues. You will play a key role in enabling Operations to move beyond day\-to\-day business\-as\-usual, fostering innovation, scalability, and a brighter future for all.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer and Service Journey Transformation**
* Lead mapping and analysis of key customer, distributor, and service journeys to identify areas of improvement and standardization, pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities for simplification and consistency.
* Translate journey insights into actionable improvements that enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness.


**Process Improvement and Standardization**
* Lead process improvement and standardization across core operational activities.

The CoS acts as a thought partner to leadership, orchestrates cross\-functional collaboration with Finance, Business Development, Marketing, Legal, Talent, IT, Knowledge, and Events, and ensures that commercial performance, investments, and people decisions are tightly aligned to the business’s strategic goals.  Events planning \& management — working with Marketing
   

  

**Experience Required:**

As we scale our footprint and onboard major corporate clients, we are looking for a world\-class Head of Travel Operations to lead our mission\-critical delivery functions.
 



 This is a high\-impact leadership role designed for a "builder" who thrives at the intersection of traditional travel expertise and modern startup agility. You will bridge the gap between legacy industry workflows and our digital\-first model, ensuring our operational backbone is as innovative as our technology.
 



 Reporting to the executive team, you will stabilize, scale, and professionalize our travel operations. You aren't just managing a team; you are protecting our reputation, nurturing critical supplier relationships, and architecting an operational playbook that can support our next phase of explosive growth.
 



  





  





 3️⃣

* **Lead Regional Operations:** 
 Oversee the daily activities of travel consultants, ensuring peak productivity and service excellence.
* **Strengthen Partnerships:** 
 Act as the primary interface for key suppliers and airlines, managing high\-stakes communication with professional precision.

 Bridge the gap between GDS systems (Amadeus/Travelport) and our proprietary tech stack to automate and optimize workflows.

**Who We Are**
 At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:
 *We Before Me* 
 ,
 *Do the Right Thing* 
 , and
 *Get Things Done* 
 . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK\-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Chief Operating Officer (COO) to lead the operational and commercial functions of our UAE Business. This role will oversee the full operational lifecycle—including Sales, Trading, Customer Operations, and Business Support ensuring our business runs efficiently, compliantly, and in alignment with regulatory requirements. The COO will act as a key partner to the regional CEO and global leadership, driving growth, operational excellence, and cross\-functional collaboration across the organization.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Executive Operations \& Strategy**
* Oversee day\-to\-day business and commercial operations for the UAE\-regulated entity across Sales, Trading, and Operations.
* Implement scalable, efficient operational systems that align with global and regional business objectives.
* Track and report key KPIs across commercial performance, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and risk.
* Partner with the CEO of Middle East and collaborate closely with global leadership to shape and execute strategic initiatives.


**Sales, Trading \& Operational Oversight**
* Provide operational leadership across the sales processes, onboarding, and customer lifecycle management.
* Oversee trading operations, ensuring effective controls, timely issue escalation, and operational resilience.
* Optimize operational support for customer operations and post\-trade processes.
* Support commercial strategy through data\-driven insights, operational improvements, and performance management.


**Product Strategy \&** 
**Localization**
* Partner with global Product, Engineering, and Ops teams to tailor products for the UAE market.
* Ensure operational readiness and internal alignment for new product launches.
* Lead cross\-functional evaluations to confirm compliance with UAE regulatory standards.


**Compliance \& Risk Management**
* Embed UAE regulatory standards into operational workflows
* Act as the first line of defense, ensuring operational activities meet regulatory requirements.
* Maintain risk registers, lead incident reviews, and ensure internal governance discipline.
* Work closely with Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to support regulatory reporting, audits, and supervisory engagement.


**Performance \& Metrics Monitoring**
* Build and monitor KPIs across commercial, operational, and risk domains.
* Produce regular performance reports for senior management and regulatory stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational effectiveness.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Customer Ops, Sales, and Trading teams.
* Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and high performance.


**What We Look For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA preferred.
* 10\+ years of operational leadership within regulated financial services, fintech, trading, brokerage, or crypto.
* Strong experience operating in a similar role in a regulated UAE financial/fintech institution (SCA/VARA/FSRA/DFSA preferred).
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams and develop scalable operational frameworks.
* Strong commercial acumen with demonstrated involvement in Sales and Trading operations.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to thrive in dynamic, high\-growth environments.


**What Will Make You Stand Out**
* Experience in a regulated UAE financial institution, or equivalent international markets..
* Strong understanding of blockchain, digital assets, trading infrastructure, and market structure.
* Demonstrated success in scaling operations and driving regulatory compliance transformation.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with passion for innovation and operational excellence.


**Perks \& Benefits**
* Competitive total compensation package
* L\&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
* Various team building programs and company events
* Wellness and meal allowances
* Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
* More that we love to tell you along the process!


**Notice**
 All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third\-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated.
 **If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.**
 Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

data.jd_text:
**About Joby**
 Joby is a next\-generation aviation company redefining what’s possible in sustainable, zero\-emissions flight—making clean, accessible air travel a reality worldwide. Headquartered in California, Joby is certifying an all\-electric, vertical take\-off and landing air taxi to operate a fast, quiet, and on\-demand air taxi service in cities around the world and sell its aircraft to other operators and partners.
   

  

 By leveraging our deep vertical integration, we are uniquely positioned to lead the transformation of air mobility. Our approach allows us to move quickly, maintain quality at every step, and deliver a seamless experience for passengers and partners alike.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The UAE team at Joby is growing, and we're looking to bring on a new dynamic team member to launch our operations in Abu Dhabi. The UAE will be Joby Aviation’s inaugural launch market worldwide, and the local team is at the forefront of shaping the regulatory framework, operational model, infrastructure, and customer experience that will define urban air mobility globally.
   

  

 Operating under Joby’s own Air Operator Certificate, the UAE team works in close partnership with federal and local government entities, semi\-government organizations, and strategic partners to bring safe, scalable, and sustainable air mobility to life.
   

  

**Overview**
**About the Role**
 The Manager, Business Operations will work directly with Joby’s UAE General Manager to prepare the Abu Dhabi market for a successful commercial launch and long\-term scale. This role sits at the intersection of operations, business development, manufacturing integration, and strategic execution.
   

  

 You will manage complex, cross\-functional initiatives; support commercial and government partnerships; and translate global strategies into executable local plans. Success in this role requires strong program management skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving, ambiguous, and highly regulated environment.
   

  

 Joby’s presence in Abu Dhabi will span flight operations, business development, manufacturing and assembly integration, and ecosystem partnerships, and this role will play a key part in coordinating across these areas.
   

  

 This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Remote work is not permitted.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with government and semi\-government stakeholders across the UAE to establish and scale Joby’s operational presence, supporting regulatory alignment, commercial agreements, and long\-term strategic partnerships.
* Lead cross\-functional launch initiatives in close coordination with Joby’s global teams across operations, manufacturing, engineering, legal, finance, and policy
* Develop financial and operational models to support strategic planning, investment decisions, and long\-range forecasting
* Program\-manage local operations, including aircraft assembly, manufacturing enablement, supply\-chain coordination, and operational readiness, translating global plans into executable local programs.
* Drive business development and market analysis, identifying growth opportunities, evaluating partnerships, and supporting negotiations with public and private sector counterparties.
* Act as a strategic integrator between global subject\-matter experts and local stakeholders, ensuring Joby’s technical, operational, and commercial capabilities are effectively deployed in the UAE market.
* Support the UAE General Manager on special projects, executive briefings, and strategic initiatives critical to launching and scaling Joby’s first global market.


**Required**
**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, strategy \& operations, investment banking, or management consulting, with exposure to aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, or infrastructure
* Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including building and maintaining financial models, operating plans, and multi\-scenario business cases.
* Proven ability to manage complex, cross\-functional programs, coordinating multiple stakeholders in fast\-moving and ambiguous environments.
* Demonstrated experience working within the UAE ecosystem, including engagement with government and semi\-government entities.
* Arabic proficiency is preferred, but not a requirement.
* A self\-starter with a get\-it\-done mindset that thrives in dynamic and fast\-paced environments.
* Flexibility to work across time zones (including occasional US business hours) and willingness to travel regionally and internationally as needed.

data.jd_text:
The Division Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and day to day operations of a fitness \& Wellness facility within MTM Group in Qatar. This role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless delivery of a premium member experience while maintaining the highest standards across all operational, commercial, and service functions.
 



  





 The Division Manager will oversee all aspects of the facility, including membership sales performance, retention strategies, staff management, and operational efficiency. They are accountable for driving revenue growth, optimizing member engagement, and ensuring the facility consistently meets both commercial targets and brand standards.
 



  





 A key component of the role involves leading and developing a multidisciplinary team, including sales, front of house, and fitness staff, ensuring high levels of accountability, productivity, and service excellence. The Division Manager must foster a strong performance culture, implement structured processes, and continuously elevate team capability through coaching and oversight.
 



  





 From an operational perspective, the role requires strict adherence to health and safety standards, facility maintenance, scheduling, and service delivery protocols, ensuring a smooth and professional environment at all times. The Division Manager will also collaborate closely with senior leadership to execute strategic initiatives, marketing campaigns, and business development opportunities aligned with MTM Group’s growth objectives.
 



  





 Ultimately, this position demands a results driven, commercially aware, and people focused leader who can balance operational control with customer experience, delivering a facility that is both high performing and aligned with MTM Group’s premium brand and service values.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities\-
 



  





 Operational Management
 


* Oversee all day\-to\-day operations of the fitness facility, ensuring it runs efficiently, safely, and in accordance with MTM Group protocols.
* Ensure all equipment, amenities, and group fitness areas are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness and functionality.
* Enforce compliance with health and safety regulations, facility rules, and hygiene protocols.
* Implement and oversee standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all departments.



  





 Team Leadership \& Staff Management
 


* Lead, supervise, and develop a diverse team of personal trainers, receptionists, cleaners, and group fitness instructors.
* Schedule and manage shifts, leave, and staff rotations to ensure optimal coverage.
* Conduct regular team meetings, performance appraisals, and one\-on\-one coaching sessions.
* Foster a motivating and empowering work culture centered around teamwork, accountability, and customer service excellence.



  





 Member Engagement \& Retention
 


* Ensure a welcoming, professional, and comfortable environment for all members and visitors, with a strong focus on hospitality, inclusivity, and privacy.
* Handle member concerns and feedback with empathy, professionalism, and timely resolution.
* Implement member retention initiatives, including loyalty programs, engagement events, onboarding journeys, and follow\-up processes.
* Monitor member satisfaction metrics (NPS, reviews, surveys) and take corrective actions as needed.



  





 Sales \& Revenue Performance
 


* Collaborate with the sales team to drive membership sales, renewals, and upgrades.
* Track and analyze facility KPIs, including membership targets, attrition rates, group class attendance, and personal training revenue.
* Execute local marketing initiatives and work closely with the Commercial team on campaigns.
* Ensure all team members actively contribute to upselling and cross\-selling of services.



  





 Facility Presentation \& Brand Compliance
 


* Maintain consistently high standards of cleanliness, ambiance, and visual presentation in line with MTM Group brand guidelines.
* Ensure all digital screens, posters, and member touchpoints are current and aligned with ongoing promotions or campaigns.
* Enforce uniform compliance, grooming standards, and service etiquette across all departments.

**Global Head of SAP TRM (Tax \& Revenue Management)** 




  





 Function: SAP TRM practice and Digital Transformation
 



 Practice: SAP Tax \& Revenue Management
 



 Reports to: Global Head of SAP Practice, CEO
 



 Location: Global Role base Location to be Emirates or UK
 



 Team: Global matrix—Sales, Presales, Delivery, Solutioning, Alliances, PMO, and CoE
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Head of Invenio’s SAP Tax \& Revenue Management Practice is the senior executive responsible for defining, building, and leading a world‑class SAP Tax \& Revenue Management consulting practice globally, which currently represents 70% of the business revenue across 5 continents, including multiple long standing client relationships. This role oversees global strategy, solution innovation, delivery \& Technical excellence, and commercial growth across all SAP TRM‑related services.
 



 The leader will function as the primary authority on SAP TRM, guiding new and existing clients, internal teams, and partners through complex tax, revenue, and public‑sector transformation programs and GTM strategies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\) Strategy \& Portfolio Leadership** 



* Define and execute the SAP TRM growth strategy (markets, offerings, routes\-to\-market, partner plays, competitive positioning)
* Own global P\&L for the SAP TRM practice, including revenue targets, margin optimization, and resource utilization including development \& Growth of large existing portfolio.
* Client Engagement management of wide Geographic existing client base to ensure SLA.
* Lead global enterprise pursuits (public sector frameworks, national tax authorities, sub\-national revenue bodies) acting as Project sponsor.
* Drive pipeline origination with Marketing (thought leadership, events, POVs, RFP\-shaping workshops)
* Build and maintain C‑suite relationships with key clients, SAP leadership, and strategic partners.
* Oversee deal governance: bid/no\-bid, solution integrity, pricing strategy, commercials (T\&Cs, risk allocation), and negotiation.
* Support sales cycles by providing executive‑level solution leadership, bid support, and client presentations.
* Identify new market opportunities, partnerships, and service lines.



  





  





  





**2\) Delivery Excellence \& Client Outcomes** 



* Ensure on\-time, on\-budget, high\-quality TRM program delivery with strong controls (scope, RAID, change, IV\&V).
* Anchors go\-live readiness, operational acceptance, hyper care, and value realization (KPIs like collection uplift, leakage reduction, time\-to\-process).
* Chair Portfolio Delivery Reviews and major SteerCos; intervene early in red accounts.
* Establish standard delivery patterns: Agile/Scaled Agile where appropriate, data migration factories, test automation, DevSecOps.
* Prioritize industry use cases (e.g., Registration \& Case Management, Returns \& Filing, Collection \& Enforcement, Risk \& Compliance, Debt Management, Fraud Analytics, Real\-time reporting).
* Oversee successful delivery of large‑scale SAP TRM programs, ensuring quality, budget adherence, and client satisfaction.
* Establish global delivery models, including nearshore/offshore capabilities.
* Resolve escalations, mitigate risks, and ensure consistent delivery performance across regions.



**3\) Practice Building \& Talent** 



* Grow and develop a global SAP TRM capability: solution architects, functional consultants, data \& integration experts, test leads, program directors.
* Create a competency framework and certification plan (SAP TRM, SAP BTP, Integration, Data \& Analytics, Public Sector processes).
* Sponsor communities of practice, knowledge management, and re\-usable assets.
* Mentor practice leaders; succession planning for key roles.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop top SAP TRM talent across all regions, including Build structured learning paths, certification programs, and knowledge‑sharing communities.
* Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and collaboration within the practice.



  





  





**Required Experience** 



* 15\+ years in SAP\-led transformation programs; 10\+ years in Public Sector revenue/tax solutions Experience leading multi‑country, multi‑million‑dollar SAP transformation programs.
* Demonstrated success in owning a P\&L and closing $1M–20M\+ complex pursuits (frameworks, multi\-year programs)
* 5\-10 years \+ demonstrated experience in delivering and executing Fixed price SAP programmes in public sector.
* Deep knowledge of SAP TRM and adjacent components (e.g., Public Sector Collections \& Disbursements, BTP/Integration Suite, BRF\+/decisioning, Analytics, Identity \& Access, Data migration) is highly advantageous.
* Strong understanding of public‑sector revenue processes: tax assessment, billing, collections, compliance, case management.
* SAP Financial programme and process execution, ideally gained in a global SAP consulting practice.
* History of delivery turnarounds, executive stakeholder management (DG/Commissioner/CIO/CTO), and referenceable outcomes.
* Strong alliance leadership (SAP) and ecosystem orchestration (SI/ISV/Advisory).
* Experience with Cloud/S/4HANA modernization, data governance, cyber/privacy in public sector contexts.



  





 Preferred Qualifications \& Certifications
 


* SAP certifications relevant to Public Sector / TRM; SAP BTP or Integration certs a plus.
* Program/Delivery credentials (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe) beneficial.
* Bachelor’s/master’s in information systems, Public Finance, Engineering, or similar.



  





 Core Competencies
 


* Commercial Leadership: Enterprise deal strategy, shaping, pricing, and negotiation.
* Delivery Command: Complex program governance, risk management, escalation handling.
* Domain Authority: Tax lifecycle, risk/compliance, debt, digital channels, data \& analytics.
* Partnering \& Influence: C\-level presence; strong with SAP field and product teams.
* People Leadership: Build high\-performing, diverse global teams; coaching \& succession.
* Strategic Thinking: Portfolio vision, GTM orchestration, investment rationale \& ROI.
* Operational Excellence: Forecasting, P\&L management, pipeline rigor, QBR cadence.



  





**\- UAE or Saudi Arabia Base with Travel, globally expected.**

 Work with large\-scale data systems including Amazon Redshift, S3, and EMR

 Own the full software development lifecycle from design to deployment and operations

**Who are we?**
 At Finastra, we are a dynamic global provider of open finance software solutions, dedicated to expanding access to financial services. Our innovative applications span Lending, Payments, Treasury and Capital Markets, and Universal Banking. Proudly serving over 8,000 customers, including 45 of the world's top 50 banks, we aim to boost financial inclusion for all. Join us and be part of a vibrant company that embraces diverse perspectives, and is committed to doing well by doing good.
   

  

**What will you contribute?**
**The Presales and Project Management Principal** 
 is responsible for ensuring that all projects within the portfolio are delivered on time, within the client's budget, and meet or exceed financial targets, including baseline margins. This role defines project objectives and oversees quality assurance throughout the project lifecycle. A key aspect of the role is to consistently foster strong client relationships and uphold Finastra’s reputation for excellence. Additionally, the Principal ensures that all presales proposals are submitted punctually and are aligned with budget expectations in coordination with Sales and the Client.
   

  

**Principal Project Manager** 
 is responsible for managing all aspects of Large to moderately complex projects for a defined segment of strategic initiatives from project definition and intake to transition to full operational support.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Your deliverables as a
 **Principal Project Manager** 
 will include, but are not limited to, the following
   

  

* Leads and drives the development of the project intake process including developing scope, schedule and cost
* Defines the goals and objectives of specific project and defines individual team member’s roles and responsibilities for the duration of the project
* Manages multiple mid to large scale projects ensuring that they will complete on time and within budget and that the solution aligns with/meets the business objective
* Manages the daily/weekly project team assignments and monitors progress against the work plan to assure that objectives are met within the prescribed time, cost, and quality measures
* Identification and impact analysis of potential project changes and facilitation of change control board to approve or disapprove said changes.
* Meets financial objectives by forecasting requirements; preparing a project budget; scheduling expenditures analyzing variances; initiating corrective actions
* Continual identification, qualification and tracking of risks, defining mitigation and contingency plans, assigning appropriate resources, and constantly communicating status
* Responsible for identification of resource requirements and proper communication of those requirements in a timely manner to ensure the project is properly staffed with the skilled resources required
* Responsible for identifying internal and external stakeholders, understanding their communication requirements and fulfilling those requirements


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of end\-to\-end Project Management experience
* Fluent in Arabic; native\-level proficiency is highly preferred
* Experience must be with customer\-facing projects and not internal to the organization
* Experience assisting project management teams with identification of action items, tasks and activities and tracking progress
* Experience at defining, implementing and continually improving standards, processes and procedures utilizing industry best practice (PMI, CMMI, etc.)
* Experience developing project budgets based on the development of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)


**Benefits**
 We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we uphold:
   

  

* Flexibility: Enjoy unlimited vacation, based on your location and business priorities. Hybrid working arrangements, and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.
* Well\-being: Access Confidential one\-on\-one therapy through our Employee Assistance Program, find support from our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and a calendar of monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive \- Inside and Outside of work.
* Medical, life \& disability insurance, retirement plan, lifestyle and other benefits\*
* ESG: Benefit from paid time off for volunteering and donation matching.
* DEI: Participate in multiple DE\&I groups for open involvement (e.g., Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, Women@Finastra).
* Career Development: Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills \& Career Navigator tool.
* Recognition: Be part of our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and contribute to regular employee surveys to help shape Finastra and foster a culture where everyone is engaged and empowered to perform at their best.
* Specific benefits may vary by location.


 At Finastra, each individual is unique, bringing their own ideas, thoughts, cultural beliefs, backgrounds, and experiences together. We learn from one another, embrace and celebrate our differences, and create an environment where everyone feels safe to be themselves.
   

  

 Be unique, be exceptional, and help us make a difference at Finastra!

This role will be responsible to manage multiple projects simultaneously. In this role, you will be responsible for the delivery of demonstrable progress toward customer's solution usage goals, coordinate activities for assigned projects and work with colleagues to remove team obstacles or inefficiencies.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Manage all project controls, including: budget vs actual for project hours, forecast accuracy, revenue attainment.
* Manage and document changes to project scope that have an impact on company’s resource, time and/or financial commitments via a change order process.
* Provide work direction, assistance, mentoring and coaching to other team members as required.
* Manage internal and client communication of appropriate project information.
* Establish and manage relationships with client to sustain a strong business connection.

 At JAGGAER you’ll find great benefits, empowering culture, flexible work environment, much more!
   

  

 Apply now and be part of our success!

 At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies
   

  

* Transparency \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.

* Metrics\-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 At Dyson, we’re driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation—pushing boundaries in engineering, AI, and robotics. Our new Data Intelligence team sits at the heart of this mission: shaping Dyson’s future through data. Here, we blend creativity, precision, and audacity to power intelligent products. We craft data strategies and pipelines that fuel the next generation of connected devices.
   

  

 You’ll work alongside brilliant minds from Dyson global engineering team and external software/hardware partners in an environment built for exploration, discovery, delivery and impact.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Lead Data Intelligence Project Manager, you ensure that every project has the resources it needs to take off, you'll orchestrate data operations that power product development across Dyson’s global teams. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between our external project teams and our internal technical departments (Data Curation and MLOps). You will own the "data logistics" for the entire project lifecycle—from initial storage setup to final delivery of high\-quality training sets.
* You will be the strategic lead for our labelling workforce, managing the balance between our in\-house contractors and 3rd party service providers to ensure we never hit a capacity bottleneck.
* Overseeing data storage setup and maintenance to guarantee security, accessibility, and compliance.
* Maintaining rigorous documentation and workflows that ensure project transparency and repeatability.
* Supporting cross\-functional communication between data teams, contractors, and engineering partners.


**About you**
* 8\+ years in Project or Program Management, with at least 2 years specifically in AI/ML Data Operations or Data Management. You’ve delivered complex projects on time and within scope—often in fast\-changing settings.
* Demonstrated success in managing 3rd party vendors or service providers, including contract negotiation, quality assurance, issue resolution, and ongoing relationship management.
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of how data flows from collection → cleaning → labeling → training → deployment.
* Tooling Familiarity: Experience with labeling platforms (Labelbox, CVAT, Label Studio) and project management tools (Jira, Asana, or Airtable).
* Data Literacy: Basic understanding of data storage architectures (S3, SQL, Snowflake) and data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
* Communication: Exceptional "translation" skills—the ability to explain technical MLOps constraints to business stakeholders and vice versa.
* A solid understanding of modern data storage solutions (cloud, on\-premises, hybrid), including principles of data security, privacy, access control, and regulatory compliance.
* Able to translate complex technical requirements into clear actions for both technical and non\-technical audiences. You’re adept at influencing and building consensus.
* Confident interfacing with cross\-functional teams—coordinating with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and external stakeholders to deliver smooth handovers and alignment.
* Well\-versed in project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall). Known for driving continuous improvement, clear documentation, and repeatable processes.
* Thorough, highly organized, and relentless in troubleshooting issues and removing blockers before they impact delivery.
* Proactive, accountable, and comfortable juggling competing priorities. You always keep end goals in focus and balance urgency with quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or Information Technology); higher degree or PMP/Prince2 certification is a plus.


 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

data.jd_text:
The Commissioning Manager reports to the Project Director (or his designee) and the EPC Commissioning Manager for Quality Management System compliance.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  




* Responsible for HSE and QAQC compliant approaches to define and execute all scopes of work.
* Responsible for managing and achieving all commissioning, start\-up, initial operations activities and performance tests. This includes all preparatory engineering up to and including handover certification.
* Responsible for commissioning strategies that reduce the risk of interruption of operational effectiveness of the asset from start\-up onwards.
* Responsible to optimize project execution schedule at the right junctures to minimize risk to operational effectiveness.
* Interact with project stakeholders to expedite transfers of custody throughout project execution. Notably construction as a predecessor and operations as a successor.
* Drive all subcontractors, vendors and specialist subcontractors to deliver their scopes of work from mechanical completion up to and including performance testing.
* Provide day to day guidance to the commissioning team and stakeholders to achieve the project schedule.
* Define and execute work packages for Hook\-up (de\-preservation, removal of transportation / sea fastening aids, construction activities) and commissioning scopes of work offshore.
* Ensure offshore work package planning is coordination with persons responsible for onshore logistics and Marine spreads, ensuring that all needs offshore are accounted for.
* Perform the role of Offshore Installation Manager during the Hook\-up and offshore commissioning phase of work.



  





**Training** 




  




* Offshore training for German / EU coastal waters. DDW will supplement training where necessary.



  





**Responsibilities Include:** 




  




* Active leadership in DDWD zero harm ensuring both process and personal safety as well as environmental and health standards are achieved on the jobsite.
* Compliance to the Quality management system and necessary tailoring for project and client needs.
* Own project specific commissioning test procedures ensuring that commissioning leads deliver these procedures to a consistent standard.
* Own all procedures, management related and execution related.
* Contribute to constructability concepts for commissioning by working with Engineering and Construction to realise these.
* Lead the progression through ‘livening up’ and parallel path activities and control the associated hazards.
* Ensure the Permit to Work system is used effectively by the commissioning team for livening up, lock out tag out etc. as part of work planning and execution.
* Develop concepts to reduce punch lists / open items in predecessor and successor activities.
* Interface with Regulatory bodies to ensure requirements are incorporated, planned and adequately demonstrated.
* Directly oversee all commissioning leads at the jobsite.
* Lead the definition of the overall completions and commissioning scope of work, execute and maintain all systems until handover to operations is achieved.
* Facilitate transfers of custody with joint walkdowns and adequate participation of the commissioning team.
* Ensure management of change is adhered to by all commissioning leads and their reports.
* Control the completions and commissioning budget and the mobilization of all identified resources within the budget to execute the project schedule.
* Drive tightness and cleanliness compliance with contractors and Piping Process Service providers.
* Provide assurance and oversight of client contractors.
* Ensure first fills are compiled into a register ready for handover to operations and that all fills are conducted as per Original Equipment Manufacturer Installation and Operation Maintenance Manual requirements.
* Ensure all progress reporting / KPIs are updated per specified frequencies.
* Ensure all completion and commissioning documents are entered into the project completion commissioning management system database.
* Coordinate all matters arising that may require the support of Engineering, suppliers, client and or operations.
* Ensure disposal of hazardous substances or waste generated during all phases of commissioning including waste segregation.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 15 years post graduate or Apprenticeship experience in the Marine or Renewables sector. Oil and Gas experience welcomed.
* 5 plus years in the role of a Lead commissioning engineer or Operation (for e.g. Chief Engineer).
* 5 plus years in the role as Commissioning Manager.

STRUCTURAL integrates technology\-driven solutions with specialty contracting services to improve, protect, and enhance the existing infrastructure of owners directly, and in partnership with designers and contractors. STRUCTURAL offers a wide range of specialty repair and maintenance services and is the largest concrete repair contractor in the United States, with roughly 2,500 employees working from locations nationwide and in select international markets. STRUCTURAL is the open\-shop contracting business line of Structural Group.
   

  

 STRUCTURAL integrates technology\-driven solutions with specialty contracting services to improve, protect, and enhance the existing infrastructure of owners directly, and in partnership with designers and contractors. STRUCTURAL offers a wide range of specialty repair and maintenance services and is the largest concrete repair contractor in the United States, with roughly 4,500 employees working from locations nationwide and in select international markets. STRUCTURAL has been established in UAE since 2008 and has offices/operations in Qatar and KSA.
   

  

 We are currently recruiting for a Senior Project Manager to be based in our Dubai office supporting projects throughout the UAE. As a Senior Project Manager for STRUCTURAL, you will be responsible for managing complex construction projects that make the structures of the UAE and GCC stronger and last longer.
   

  

**As a Successful Candidate, You Will Be Responsible For**
* Managing self\-performed complex repair and restoration projects
* Preparing contracts and negotiating revisions while working with internal contracts teams as needed
* Developing and managing schedules in collaboration with field leadership
* Maintaining profit \& loss responsibility as well as other project financials including projections, etc.
* Providing strong leadership, mentorship and supervision to Project Managers, Field Managers, Project Engineers, and subcontractors
* Working closely with in\-house Estimators and Sales teams to assist in reviewing bids and developing proposals.
* Evaluating risk and loss exposure on projects managed
* Developing and maintaining strong customer relationships
* Demonstrating dedication to safety and quality control on all projects


 Candidates who meet the following criteria may be considered for this exciting position:
   

  

* Excellent written and verbal English communication and technical writing
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering/construction management or related field of study
* 12\+ years of relevant experience within the Commercial construction and / or restoration industry
* Ability to speak and write in Arabic preferred
* Demonstrated capability to successfully manage construction projects.
* Previous experience managing projects that include structural concrete repair, waterproofing, façade repair and/or historic restoration.
* Proven knowledge of computer\-based programs including Microsoft Office as well as project management and forecasting tools
* Strong leadership skills to effectively train and mentor others.
* The ability to work effectively with a team
* Capable of managing multiple projects and ensuring successful and on\-time delivery
* Job location is in the UAE with flexibility to travel within the GCC


 Our ideal candidate is an innovative but decisive individual who can work effectively in a highly collaborative, team\-based environment; has the ability to set goals and expectations and hold others accountable; can encourage and mentor others; is approachable, empathetic and outgoing; can quickly gain trust and respect; and is able to establish and maintain relationships.

data.jd_text:
**About Valtech**
 At Valtech, we are reshaping the way brands connect with their customers. As a global digital innovation company, we fuse creativity, technology, and strategy to solve complex business challenges and deliver exceptional experiences.
   

  

 With over 6,500 experts in 60\+ offices across 20\+ countries, we are expanding our footprint in MENA with Dubai as the strategic hub. At Valtech we thrive on driving business transformation as trusted partners to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values\-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are part of Valtech MENA, the experience innovation company, combining the uncommon to unlock a better way for people to experience the world. We work at the intersection of disciplines, cultures, and perspectives to create solutions that go beyond expectations, helping brands move ahead and lead in a digital world.
   

  

 We value clarity, collaboration, and a strong respect for craft. That mindset shapes both what we create and how we work together.
   

  

**Overview**
 We are looking for an Experience Operations Lead to take ownership of how experience design is delivered across projects.
   

  

 This role focuses on turning strong experience direction into high quality, well structured delivery. You will ensure that ideas hold up through the realities of timelines, tools, team dynamics, and technical constraints, without losing clarity or intent.
   

  

 You will define how delivery works, support teams in executing it, and ensure a consistent standard across all work.
   

  

**The role**
 You are responsible for making sure that experience design is delivered properly, consistently, and at a high level of quality.
   

  

 You work from a clear experience direction and help shape how it is delivered in practice. You are not solely responsible for defining the vision, but you contribute to how it evolves through real delivery.
   

  

 You create clarity where there is complexity and structure where there is ambiguity. You care about craft and about the systems that allow that craft to scale.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
**Delivery and execution**
* Own the delivery of experience design work across projects and clients
* Translate experience direction into clear and actionable plans
* Ensure UX, UI, motion, and content outputs are consistent and high quality
* Make decisions to maintain quality under real constraints
* Protect the integrity of the experience through handover to engineering


**Delivery strategy and standards**
* Define how experience design is delivered across projects and programs
* Establish clear standards for workflows, documentation, and quality
* Work closely with leadership to shape delivery approaches
* Balance quality, speed, and feasibility in day to day work


**Design operations and workflow**
* Establish scalable ways of working across teams and projects
* Improve collaboration between design, product, and engineering
* Define and apply documentation standards that teams can follow
* Support delivery across geographies and with external partners
* Create clarity in how work moves from concept to execution


**Team support and production**
* Support designers in their day to day work
* Manage resourcing, timelines, and coordination
* Remove blockers so teams can focus on design
* Help maintain consistency and quality across the team


**AI and operational improvement**
* Explore how AI and tools can improve workflows and delivery
* Identify opportunities to automate and simplify work
* Support the team in adopting new tools in a practical way
* Continuously improve how the team works


**How You Work With Others**
 You work from clear experience direction while collaborating closely with design, product, and engineering teams.
   

  

 You are the point of authority for experience delivery within projects. You guide teams and stakeholders toward decisions that support both quality and feasibility.
   

  

 You work closely with the Head of Experience and other leads, contributing to how the department evolves while owning delivery within your scope.
   

  

**Experience**
**What we are looking for**
* 8 or more years in digital design, product, or experience delivery
* Strong hands on background across UX and UI
* Experience leading delivery or improving design operations
* Comfortable working with cross functional teams and clients


**Core Skills**
* Strong understanding of UX and UI in real delivery environments
* Clear sense of quality and attention to detail
* Ability to structure work and create clarity in complex situations
* Confident working with tools, documentation, and workflows
* Calm and organized under pressure


**Additional Strengths**
* Experience with design systems and scalable approaches
* Understanding of front end, motion, or interaction design
* Interest in using AI and modern tools to improve delivery


**Your application process**
 Once you apply, our Recruitment team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps. ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com. We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let us know.
   

  

**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity \& Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

**It's more than a job**
 In an administrative role at Kuehne\+Nagel, tasks such as managing office operations or coordinating schedules certainly contribute to your team's success, but they also provide meaningful moments for people around the world. Because your attention to detail supports your colleagues to perform at their best, such as ensuring the timely and seamless transport of hearing aids and advanced medical devices that change lives. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our work contributes to more than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 The primary purpose of the Global Project Logistics Transport Engineering Manager is to develop, maintain, and implement technical standards across Kuehne\+Nagel’s global project logistics operations. This role plays a critical part in mitigating risk exposure, increasing the win ratio of project bids, and driving operational excellence.
   

  

 The position requires the use of CAD applications to create technical drawings and develop load‑securing concepts for overland transportation, including but not limited to road, rail, barge transfer, and site laydown operations. The role gathers, translates, and prioritizes customer and operational requirements into actionable technical initiatives, while providing hands‑on support for on‑site operations and HSE‑related activities.
   

  

 This role ensures strong technical support and effective knowledge transfer for both internal and external stakeholders, enabling seamless customer implementations and the adoption of new technical solutions. Additionally, the position contributes to the organization’s transformation agenda by advancing sustainability within global project logistics engineering.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* The role interacts extensively with global and national project logistics teams, business units, functional units , customers, suppliers, and technology partners.
* Perform cargo securing calculations to ensure safe transport for all possible modes of transport.
* Develop technical drawings, including 2D and 3D CAD designs
* Conduct route and site surveys, as well as feasibility studies
* Select appropriate equipment based on vendor drawings and site conditions
* Supervise operations and conduct pre\-shipment inspections
* Develop comprehensive journey management plans to optimize transport routes and schedules


**What we would like you to bring**
* University degree in engineering or a related technical field.
* Experience in project logistics or freight forwarding, ideally in large‑scale projects.
* Strong project management background, including solution design and technical implementation.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills across cultures and functions.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, perform calculations, and work with 2D/3D CAD tools.
* Good understanding of transport regulations, engineering standards, and HSSE requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
* Willingness to travel for site surveys, operations, and customer engagements.


**What's in it for you**
 A role that offers international exposure, hands‑on involvement in complex project logistics operations, and the opportunity to develop both technical and managerial capabilities. You will work closely with global teams, customers, and suppliers, gaining valuable experience across engineering, operations, and project execution. The position provides continuous learning, professional development opportunities, and a clear pathway for career growth within a dynamic, multicultural environment.
   

  

**Who are we**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

**Trading Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Lead and scale the crypto trading function across Spot, Derivatives, OTC, and Market Making.
* Define and execute the overall trading strategy in alignment with the company’s growth plans, platform roadmap, and commercial objectives.
* Take ownership of the trading desk’s performance, operating model, and long\-term capability buildout.
* Develop a clear framework for how the business prices risk, sources liquidity, manages execution, and supports product growth.



  





**Derivatives, OTC \& Pricing** 



* Lead the design and launch of the derivatives trading capability from the ground up, including perpetual products, funding logic, hedging frameworks, and exposure management — this is a greenfield build requiring someone who has stood up a derivatives desk before.
* Lead the development of OTC pricing and execution frameworks, including liquidity sourcing, cross\-venue hedging logic, and real\-time pricing across crypto and fiat pairs.
* Ensure pricing, execution, and risk systems reflect actual market behaviour and support sustainable commercial performance.
* Improve the desk’s ability to manage complex market conditions, funding dynamics, and non\-linear risk.



  





**Market Making, Liquidity \& Market Structure** 



* Design and oversee
 **market\-making strategies** 
 to optimise liquidity, spreads, order book depth, and execution efficiency.
* Define and execute
 **liquidity strategy across exchanges and providers** 
 , improving access, reducing slippage, and enhancing execution quality.
* Shape
 **market structure, execution workflows, and venue strategy** 
 to support client flow and platform growth.
* Develop frameworks to manage
 **flow dynamics, adverse selection, and client behaviour** 
 effectively.

 **CEX and DEX environments (including AMMs)** 
 , optimising execution in both off\-chain and on\-chain markets.
* Oversee integration with
 **custodial providers (e.g. Fireblocks)** 
 , addressing latency, settlement, and operational coordination.
* Drive
 **end\-to\-end latency optimisation** 
 across order routing, signing, and on\-chain settlement.
* Maintain
 **tight spreads and consistent market depth across venues** 
 , managing fragmented liquidity and multi\-exchange listings.



  





**Token Strategy \& Exchange Engagement** 



* Lead token trading and liquidity strategy, including managing simultaneous listings across multiple Tier 1 CEXs, coordinating with exchange listing teams, meeting liquidity requirements, and managing launch windows and post\-listing market support.
* Manage cross\-exchange price consistency, arbitrage mitigation, and unified order book strategy to minimise price discrepancies and adverse arbitrage pressure when the token is live on multiple venues.
* Work closely with relevant stakeholders on exchange relationships, listing processes, and ongoing liquidity support across key venues.
* Ensure token and exchange strategy are underpinned by strong compliance awareness, including wash trading monitoring, market manipulation prevention, and adherence to exchange\-specific listing rules and regulatory requirements.



  





**Spot Platform \& Exchange Infrastructure** 



* Oversee spot trading pair selection, curation, and lifecycle management on the MBIO platform, ensuring pairs are commercially viable and supported by adequate liquidity.
* Bring hands\-on experience with
 **matching engine architecture, order book design, and trade settlement workflows** 
 , working with technology teams to deliver best\-in\-class execution and liquidity on the platform.
* Optimise on\-platform settlement processes and ensure seamless integration between the matching engine, custodial layer, and external liquidity sources.



  





**Risk, Governance \& Infrastructure** 



* Own risk management across trading books, liquidity operations, token\-related exposure, and counterparty activity.
* Build robust controls around inventory, hedging, funding, execution, liquidity, and operational escalation.
* Partner with technology teams on execution tools, APIs, pricing systems, automation, and trading infrastructure.
* Ensure that trading activity operates within a strong governance and compliance framework suitable for a serious and growing platform.



  





**Cross\-functional Leadership** 



* Work closely with Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and senior management to align trading strategy with business objectives.
* Act as the senior internal owner for all matters related to trading logic, liquidity architecture, market structure, and execution design.
* Support decisions that sit across commercial strategy and trading reality, ensuring the platform is built in a way that is both scalable and market\-relevant.



  





**Reporting \& Senior Management Communication** 



* Establish and maintain
 **structured reporting frameworks** 
 covering trading performance, P\&L, risk exposure, liquidity metrics, and market conditions, ensuring senior management has full visibility at all times.
* Deliver regular dashboards, commentary, and strategic updates to the executive team, translating complex trading dynamics into clear, actionable insights.
* Proactively escalate material risks, market events, or operational issues with clear recommendations and proposed action plans.



  





**Team Building \& Management** 



* Build, lead, and mentor a high\-calibre trading team and supporting trading operations capability.
* Create a culture of accountability, speed, analytical rigour, and disciplined execution.
* Strengthen the function in a way that supports scale without compromising control, performance, or market edge.'



  





**Candidate Profile:** 




  




* 7\+ years of experience in
 **crypto trading, derivatives, OTC, liquidity management, or market making.**
* Proven track record of
 **building or leading a crypto trading function** 
 within a structured or institutional environment.
* Strong expertise in
 **derivatives trading** 
 , including perpetuals, funding, hedging, pricing, and risk management.
* Solid experience in
 **OTC execution, liquidity sourcing, market making, and cross\-venue trading strategies.**

 **market structure, liquidity dynamics, exchange microstructure, and client flow behaviour.**

 **tier\-1 crypto exchanges, liquidity providers, and token\-related trading environments** 
 (including listings or post\-launch support).

 **quantitative or systematic trading concepts** 
 , with the ability to collaborate with technical teams.

 , including latency and settlement considerations.

 **trading infrastructure** 
 , including matching engines, order books, and execution systems.

 in high\-pressure market conditions.



  





**Preferred Background:**

With the rise of big data, edge computing and the cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Technical Program Manager/Scrum Master – Global Data Center Segment.** 
 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation

* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.

 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility
