Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.

data.jd_text:
**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.
* Liaise with Ministries of Education and local education councils.
* Develop data\-driven, multi\-year enrollment projection scenarios to establish capacity parameters and budgetary requirements.
* Monitor and assess the growth of the external student sponsorship program and strengthen relationships with sponsoring organizations.
* Represent the university at media events and on\- and off\-campus recruitment functions.
* Develop a recruitment and new\-student communications plan, guiding prospects from initial inquiry through matriculation.
* Develop and implement, in consultation with the recruitment team, an annual comprehensive recruitment campaign plan.
* Co\-manage, with the Strategic Communications and Marketing department, the development of communication plans and the implementation of promotional tools for recruitment campaigns (e.g., social media, advertising).
* Engage colleges/schools, faculty, alumni, and various AUS departments in recruitment efforts to achieve enrollment goals.
* Establish partnership agreements with select high schools locally and internationally to attract highly qualified applicants.
* Lead the integration of automation and artificial intelligence solutions to enhance enrollment operations, improve applicant experience, increase efficiency, and transition key processes from manual to data\-driven digital workflows.


**Qualifications And Skills Required**
* Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Higher Education Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Proficiency in written and spoken Arabic is considered an asset.
* Strong understanding of the higher education landscape, including emerging trends, regulatory frameworks, and best practices in enrollment management.
* Solid background in developing and implementing admissions policies, academic credential evaluation standards, and related governance frameworks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of diverse high school education systems, grading models, student recruitment strategies, and yield management practices.
* Up\-to\-date expertise in leveraging digital marketing, social media, branding strategies, and evolving demographic trends to support enrollment growth.
* Understanding of the relationship between enrollment strategies and student retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop accurate enrollment projections and execute long\-term enrollment strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Effective and focused leader with a proven ability to build and motivate high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong stakeholder engagement and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Proven ability to manage budgets efficiently and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in enrollment management systems, data analytics and visualization tools, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong crisis management and change management capabilities.
* Visionary, innovative, and adaptable leadership style.
* Persuasive, collaborative, and culturally sensitive.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with sound judgment.
* Demonstrates integrity, transparency, fairness, and ethical leadership
* Expert in enrollment data analysis, predictive modeling, CRM tools, and admissions software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Higher Education Administration and Management.


**How To Apply**
* Interested applicants should fill out the form.
* AUS alumni are encouraged to apply. Applicants who do not meet specified requirements will not be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
* AUS is an equal opportunity employer. We adhere to a policy of making employment decisions without regard to race, color, age, gender, religion, national origin, disability or marital status. Opportunities for employment are based solely upon one’s qualifications.

 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Real Estate \& Hospitality banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates' day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 Client and Market Analysis
   

  

* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.
* Demonstrate understanding of the sector across all RE asset classes
* Originate new business opportunities with new to bank target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Cross collaborate to obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, Mandate letter etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals to expand RE market share
* Anchor Strategic Alliances with UAE’s Top Developers, Authorities, and sector experts
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions, keeping with RE cycles and thematics
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the
* Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks and attend industry events to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.


 Business Origination
   

  

 Client Relationship Management
   

  

* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Establish appropriate monitoring of client relationships and the underlying RE portfolio performance
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.


 Collaboration
   

  

* Align with the relevant Real Estate teams across the bank (credit, products) as well as other partners (international FAB offices) to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).


 Operational
   

  

* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.


 Leadership
   

  

* Act as Role Model for the entire Real Estate \& Hospitality group and Real Estate team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short \& long term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.


 Minimum Qualification
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.


**Minimum Experience**
 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes**
* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or investment banking.
* Demonstrable RE Sector knowledge and experience.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyse and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

data.jd_text:
Provide overall leadership and accountability for delivery of assigned project(s) from contract award through completion and close\-out, ensuring HSE, quality, schedule, cost, margin, and client satisfaction objectives are achieved. Own the project execution strategy, governance, resource planning, risk and change control, and stakeholder management—driving predictable delivery and strong commercial outcomes.
 



  





**Policies, processes \& procedures:** 




  




* Develops and oversees the implementation of department policies, procedures and controls covering all areas of finance functional activity so that all relevant procedural/legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality, cost\-effective service to customers.
* Maintain compliance with all company policies, procedures, and codes of conduct, including strict adherence to the Zero Tolerance to Alcohol policy at all times.



  





**Budget/Financial** 




  




* Prepares and recommends the department budget by preparing analysis and data related to specific elements as directed.
* Monitors the financial performance of the section against budgets so that areas of unsatisfactory performance are identified and rectified promptly and potential performance improvement opportunities are capitalised upon.



  





**Day\-to\-day operations:** 




  




* Responsible for leading asigned project project including liaising with the client; coordinating and leading partners; supervising members of the project team and project managers; and overseeing project implementation.
* Establish project governance: organization structure, RACI, reporting cadence, decision forums, and stage\-gate controls.
* Approve and drive the Project Execution Plan (PEP) and ensure integrated execution across Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning, and Yard/Marine operations (as applicable).

* Lead commercial strategy with Contracts/Legal to protect company interests and ensure contractual discipline in correspondence and notifications.
* Protect project margin through robust cost control, productivity improvement, and proactive claims/variation management.and administrative oversight, reporting, and monitoring and evaluation of the project.
* Demonstrate leadership in making critical decisions, operating at a strategic and tactical level.
* Receive regular reports from project managers or team leads. Thereafter, report directly to senior management and JV board.
* Manage Engineering, Procurement, Construction and handover process with required quality within the allocated budget.
* Making strategic decisions and providing leadership and direction to project managers to implement those decisions.
* Meeting with clients, stakeholders and project managers to report on project progress.
* Liaising with clients and building strong working relationships.
* Devising cost\-effective plans to enable effective project completion.
* Managing risks to avoid delays, cost increase or reputational damage. Convert risks and treats to opportunities.
* Ensuring compliance with rules and regulations governing the project.
* Moving with the project team during execution phase from engineering office to construction site.
* Ensure the design is safe and principles of ALARP and Safety in Design are adhered to.
* Endure the project is executed to highest HSE standards.
* Deliver the project within the allocated budget with required quality on time.



  





**Safety, Quality, Environment \& Information Security Rules:** 




  




* Ensuring suitable resources are available to achieve satisfactory OHS compliance of all work within their responsibility

* Participating in any training and safety initiatives implemented by the Company
* Complying with all Safety directives, and work instructions
* Immediately reporting any incident or potential hazard to their Supervisor or Safety Dept
* STOP the task if you feel yourself or others may be harmed.
* Device and implement controls to ensure no violation of ISR regulations in order to protect the company information / intellectual properties



  





**Leadership and People Management:** 




  




* Supervises the activities and work of subordinates by providing formal and informal feedback to ensure that all work within a specific area is carried out in an efficient manner and in accordance with set individual targets.



  





**Change Management** 




  




* Support the management of change through continuous improvement of departmental systems, processes and practices taking into account ‘international best practice’, changes in international standards and changes in the business environment which demand proactive action plans.



  





**Continuous improvement** 




  




* Stimulates subordinates and contributes to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of systems, processes and practices taking into account ‘international best practice’, improvement of business processes, cost reduction and productivity improvement.



  





**Reporting** 




  




* Supervises the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet company and department requirements, policies and standards



  





**Related Assignments:** 




  




* Performs other related duties or assignments as directed.



  





**Technical competencies:** 




  




* Broad Engineering knowledge in O\&G topsides facilities, offshore construction including EPC.
* Project governance, execution planning, and interface management
* Contract administration, variations/claims, commercial risk control
* Project controls (schedule, cost, progress, forecasting)

* Strong background with resolution of technical issues during planning and execution phases.

**Behavioral Competencies:** 




  




* Strong coordination and stakeholder management across disciplines and construction teams.
* Analytical problem\-solving with practical, buildable solutions.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and quality mindset.
* Coaching/mentoring capability and willingness to develop team capability.
* Clear communication and ability to present technical matters to non\-specialists.

* Problem solving and decision making.

* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

* Possess cultural awareness \& sensitivity and be flexible and demonstrate sound work ethics.
* Maintain strict professionalism and wear business attire/ follow dress code to reflect the company's professional image.



  





**Education** 




  





 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering / marine engineering / Naval Architect or equivalent
 



 Master’s Degree in relevant field.

 Project Management.

 Demonstrated competence in contracts, change/claims, schedule and cost control, and stakeholder management.

**Senior Relationship Manager (External Asset Management)** 




**Location: DIFC** 




**Salary:** 
 AED 40,000 \- AED 70,000 plus strong commission and 50/50 split on book of business brought over.
 



**Important:** 
 Our client are interested in candidates who have worked in London, Switzerland (Geneva/Zurich) and similar locations who have experience working with leading banking institutions or asset management firms and have built a client book of assets they manage
 



**Company Overview** 




 The firm is a Dubai based, DFSA regulated investment and advisory business providing bespoke investment solutions to high net worth and institutional clients. The firm focuses on disciplined investment strategies, long term capital growth, and client centric advice across public and private markets, working closely with strategic partners to access differentiated investment opportunities.
 



**Role Overview** 




 The Senior Relationship Manager is responsible for leading client relationship initiatives, driving business growth, and ensuring the delivery of high quality investment and advisory services. The role focuses on strategic client engagement, business development, and the ongoing development of tailored investment solutions aligned with client objectives and market opportunities.
 



 Acting as a senior liaison between clients, partners, and internal teams, the Senior Director plays a key role in strengthening client relationships, enhancing market presence, and supporting sustainable revenue growth.
 



 The ideal candidate should have AUM of $40,000,000\+ and will come from an asset management or institutional investment background, with strong exposure to portfolio construction, investment strategy, and client advisory at a sophisticated level. Experience working with high net worth or institutional clients is essential, alongside the ability to articulate investment ideas, market views, and portfolio outcomes with credibility and clarity.
 



 Candidates from a wealth management background may also be considered, provided they have worked in a discretionary or advisory led environment with complex client needs, and can demonstrate genuine investment depth rather than a purely sales driven approach. The role requires an individual who is commercially minded, comfortable engaging senior clients, and capable of bridging investment strategy with relationship management in a regulated, institutional setting.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Relationship \& Advisory Management** 




 Build, maintain, and deepen relationships with existing and prospective clients through proactive engagement and trusted advisory support.
 



 Provide tailored investment advice and solutions aligned with client objectives, risk profiles, and prevailing market conditions.
 



 Conduct regular in\-person and virtual client meetings, including proactive portfolio reviews at least every six months.
 



 Serve as a senior point of contact for client inquiries, ensuring timely, professional, and high quality responses.
 



 Address and resolve client issues or complaints efficiently, coordinating with internal teams where required.
 



 Educate clients on the firm’s investment philosophy, strategies, and product offering.
 



**Strategic \& Business Development** 




 Contribute to the formulation and execution of the firm’s business development and client acquisition strategy.
 



 Research and analyse market conditions, investment opportunities, and macroeconomic trends to support informed client advice and strategic decision making.
 



 Identify opportunities for business growth, strategic partnerships, and product development.
 



 Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure alignment between client strategies, investment execution, and operational delivery.
 



 Support initiatives aimed at improving client experience, operational efficiency, and long term commercial performance.
 



**Performance, Organisation \& Leadership** 




 Operate with a high level of organisation and efficiency, managing multiple priorities while delivering against agreed KPIs and revenue targets.
 



 Demonstrate initiative and autonomy in expanding client relationships and generating new business opportunities.
 



 Participate in ongoing professional development through training, workshops, and industry engagement.
 



**Compliance \& Governance** 




 Ensure full compliance with internal policies, procedures, and the firm’s code of ethics and professional conduct.
 



 Adhere at all times to DFSA regulatory requirements and applicable compliance standards.
 



**Education \& Qualifications** 




 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
 



 Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
 



 Professional qualifications such as CFA, CFP, or CAIA are advantageous.

**Description**
 At Amazon, we are working to be the most customer\-centric company on earth, striving to provide best\-in\-class delivery services. Our goal is to ensure that all customers, no matter where they live, can get their orders as quickly, accurately, and cost\-effectively as possible.
   

  

 Our last\-mile delivery team is seeking a dynamic, autonomous, and well\-organized Operations Integration Manager for the Hub Delivery program. This role will drive integration and standardization of Hub Delivery processes across the UAE AMZL Network, partnering with Country ACES, SnOP, Central Operations, AMZL Operations, Product teams, and other key stakeholders.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing environment focused on improving the delivery experience for our customers while driving operational excellence and cost efficiency.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, model, and implement new operations processes for Hub Delivery across the UAE AMZL Network, ensuring scalability and alignment with network capacity planning.
   

  

 Drive improvement initiatives for existing processes to meet cost, quality, and customer experience goals, using data\-driven insights to identify and prioritize opportunities.
   

  

 Gather and analyze operational data to establish network\-wide standards in partnership with cross\-functional teams, ensuring consistency and best practice adoption across all delivery stations.
   

  

 Build strong partnerships with operations field leaders and stakeholders (Central Operations, SnOP, DSP teams, Country ACES) to understand improvement opportunities and remove operational barriers.
   

  

 Analyze and solve operational blockers with a focus on root cause analysis, driving forward sustainable solutions that improve network performance and partner experience.
   

  

 Innovate to continuously improve customer experience while removing cost and complexity from the fulfillment network through process optimization and automation.
   

  

 Partner with Product teams to conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), review launch plans, pilot new features, and manage full\-scale rollouts across the network with clear success metrics.
   

  

 Represent UAE Hub Delivery operations in regional and global forums, providing insights, performance updates, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics in operations or supply chain environments.
* Advanced knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps, complex formulas) and experience with data visualization tools for operational reporting.
* Proven ability using data and metrics to determine root causes, drive improvements, and measure impact of process changes.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with technical and non\-technical teams, including operations, product, and engineering stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to translate complex operational challenges into actionable solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience, including managing multiple concurrent initiatives with competing priorities.
* Demonstrated experience driving end\-to\-end delivery of complex projects and communicating results to senior leadership with clear business impact.
* Track record of driving measurable process improvements in last\-mile delivery, logistics, or fulfillment operations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience influencing multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization without direct authority.
* Experience building processes from ground up, including project management frameworks, standard operating procedures, and implementation schedules.
* Experience with SQL, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools for operational analytics.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.

**How You’ll Make a Difference**
 At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC**
 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job \- you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about
 **Life at PwC Middle East.**

data.jd_text:
一、岗位职责
 



 1\. 战略规划与体系构建
 


* 制定共享服务中心（SSC）中长期战略，明确服务范围（涵盖人事、财务、行政等模块）及数字化转型路径，提升运营效率与成本管控效益。
* 主导跨部门流程标准化建设，包括费用报销、合同管理等核心流程，建立标准化作业流程（SOP）及合规体系，保障流程高效合规落地执行。



 2\. 全球用工合规体系搭建
 


* 牵头搭建并完善全球用工合规体系，梳理不同国家及地区（重点为海外业务所在地）的用工法律法规及政策要求，制定统一的合规指引与实施方案。
* 协同人力资源、法务及海外业务部门，规范全球用工流程，包括跨境人才派遣、劳动合同拟定、工作签证办理等，规避因区域政策差异引发的合规风险。
* 定期跟踪全球用工政策更新动态，组织团队及海外机构开展合规培训，确保SSC全流程全球服务业务严格遵循当地法规要求。



 3\. 团队管理与服务优化
 


* 全面负责SSC团队管理，涵盖招聘配置、培训赋能、绩效考核等工作，提升团队成员专业能力与服务意识，打造高绩效服务团队。
* 搭建服务质量监控体系，建立满意度调研、投诉闭环处理机制，定期分析运营数据（含时效、差错率等核心指标），推动服务体验持续迭代优化。



 4\. 数字化转型与系统落地
 


* 主导SSC数字化平台（含HR系统、财务共享系统等）的选型、实施与迭代升级，推动RPA、AI等智能化技术应用，实现核心流程自动化落地。
* 优化员工自助服务工具，包括员工门户、移动端应用等，提升数据整合能力与系统智能化水平，同时保障数据安全与合规管理。



 5\. 跨部门协作与业务支持
 


* 对接各业务部门需求，提供定制化共享服务方案，包括异地机构服务支持、政策落地配套服务等，强化与人力资源、财务、行政等部门的协同效能。
* 参与公司并购、组织调整等重大项目，提供流程适配、人员信息迁移等专项支持，保障项目高效推进。



 6\. 合规风控与持续改进
 


* 确保SSC运营全流程符合劳动法、会计准则及行业监管要求，防范薪资核算、税务申报等核心环节的操作风险，定期开展内部审计工作。
* 建立PDCA循环改进机制，复盘流程运行效率与服务交付效果，推动SSC从运营支持型职能向战略赋能型职能升级。



 二、任职要求
 



 1\. 核心能力要求
 


* 专业经验：8年以上共享服务、人力资源或财务领域管理经验，3年及以上SSC负责人岗位任职经历；具备金融/交易所行业背景者优先，需拥有大型企业全球化业务海外SSC搭建及全球用工合规体系构建经验。
* 流程管理：精通流程设计与优化方法论（如六西格玛、精益管理），具备跨部门及跨境流程落地实战案例。
* 数字化能力：熟悉HR系统、财务共享平台操作，具备RPA、AI等智能化技术应用经验，能够主导系统迭代与工具创新。
* 合规意识：通晓全球用工法律法规、财税政策及金融行业合规要求，具备丰富的跨境用工风险管控与内部审计经验。
* 语言能力：中英文双语流利，可作为工作语言；掌握其他外语者优先。



 2\. 管理与协作能力
 


* 团队管理：具备完整的团队搭建、培训赋能及绩效管理经验，善于激发团队成员主动性与创造力，打造凝聚力强的高效团队。
* 跨部门及跨境协调：具备优秀的沟通表达与资源整合能力，擅长联动业务部门、技术团队及海外机构，推进复杂项目落地。
* 战略思维：能够从公司整体战略视角规划SSC发展及全球用工合规工作，平衡短期运营效率与长期战略价值。



 3\. 学历与素养要求
 


* 学历背景：本科及以上学历，人力资源管理、财务管理、法学、信息技术等相关专业优先。
* 职业素养：结果导向，抗压能力强，具备创新思维与细节把控能力，能够适应金融行业高频次合规检查及全球业务复杂性需求。



  





 I. Job Responsibilities
 



 1\. Strategic Planning and System Construction
 


* Formulate the medium and long\-term strategy for the Shared Service Center (SSC), clarify the service scope (covering HR, Finance, Administration and other modules) and digital transformation path, and improve operational efficiency and cost control effectiveness.
* Lead the standardization of cross\-departmental processes, including core processes such as expense reimbursement and contract management, establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compliance systems, and ensure efficient and compliant implementation of processes.



 2\. Global Employment Compliance System Construction
 


* Take the lead in building and improving the global employment compliance system, sort out employment laws, regulations and policy requirements of different countries and regions (focusing on overseas business locations), and formulate unified compliance guidelines and implementation plans.
* Collaborate with HR, Legal and overseas business departments to standardize global employment processes, including cross\-border talent dispatch, employment contract formulation, work visa handling, etc., and avoid compliance risks caused by regional policy differences.
* Regularly track updates of global employment policies, organize compliance training for the team and overseas institutions, and ensure that the entire process of SSC's global service business strictly complies with local regulatory requirements.



 3\. Team Management and Service Optimization
 


* Be fully responsible for SSC team management, including recruitment and allocation, training and empowerment, performance appraisal, etc., improve team members' professional capabilities and service awareness, and build a high\-performance service team.
* Establish a service quality monitoring system, set up satisfaction surveys and closed\-loop complaint handling mechanisms, regularly analyze operational data (including core indicators such as timeliness and error rate), and promote continuous iteration and optimization of service experience.



 4\. Digital Transformation and System Implementation
 


* Lead the selection, implementation and iterative upgrading of SSC digital platforms (including HR systems, financial shared systems, etc.), promote the application of intelligent technologies such as RPA and AI, and realize the automated implementation of core processes.
* Optimize employee self\-service tools, including employee portals and mobile applications, improve data integration capabilities and system intelligence levels, and ensure data security and compliance management.



 5\. Cross\-Departmental Collaboration and Business Support
 


* Connect with the needs of various business departments, provide customized shared service solutions, including service support for remote institutions and supporting services for policy implementation, and strengthen collaboration efficiency with HR, Finance, Administration and other departments.
* Participate in major company projects such as mergers and acquisitions and organizational adjustments, provide special support such as process adaptation and personnel information migration, and ensure the efficient progress of projects.



 6\. Compliance Risk Control and Continuous Improvement
 


* Ensure that the entire SSC operation process complies with labor laws, accounting standards and industry regulatory requirements, prevent operational risks in core links such as salary calculation and tax declaration, and conduct regular internal audits.
* Establish a PDCA cycle improvement mechanism, review process operation efficiency and service delivery effects, and promote the upgrading of SSC from an operational support function to a strategic enabling function.



 II. Qualifications
 



 1\. Core Competence Requirements
 


* Professional Experience: More than 8 years of management experience in shared services, human resources or finance, with at least 3 years of experience as an SSC Director/Head. Background in the financial/exchange industry is preferred. Experience in building overseas SSCs for global businesses of large enterprises and constructing global employment compliance systems is required.
* Process Management: Proficient in process design and optimization methodologies (such as Six Sigma, Lean Management), with practical cases of cross\-departmental and cross\-border process implementation.
* Digital Capability: Familiar with the operation of HR systems and financial shared platforms, with experience in the application of intelligent technologies such as RPA and AI, and able to lead system iteration and tool innovation.
* Compliance Awareness: Well\-versed in global employment laws and regulations, fiscal and taxation policies, and financial industry compliance requirements, with rich experience in cross\-border employment risk control and internal auditing.
* Language Ability: Fluent in both Chinese and English, which can be used as working languages; proficiency in other foreign languages is a plus.



 2\. Management and Collaboration Capabilities
 


* Team Management: With complete experience in team building, training and empowerment, and performance management, good at stimulating team members' initiative and creativity, and building a cohesive and efficient team.
* Cross\-Departmental \& Cross\-Border Coordination: Excellent communication and resource integration capabilities, good at linking business departments, technical teams and overseas institutions to promote the implementation of complex projects.
* Strategic Thinking: Able to plan SSC development and global employment compliance work from the company's overall strategic perspective, balancing short\-term operational efficiency and long\-term strategic value.



 3\. Educational Background and Quality Requirements
 


* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or above, major in Human Resource Management, Financial Management, Law, Information Technology or related fields is preferred.
* Professional Qualities: Result\-oriented, strong pressure resistance, with innovative thinking and attention to details, able to adapt to the high\-frequency compliance inspection requirements of the financial industry and the complexity of global business.

**Introduction**
**Come move the world with us!**
 Wake up each day to be part of a
 **global movement** 
 . A movement to make an impact. A movement to go for it! A movement to provide best\-in class solutions. A movement to be empowered. A movement to do the right thing.
   

  

 Make AIT Worldwide Logistics the next stop on your career journey!
   

  

 See what our teammates say about working at AIT Worldwide Logistics .
   

  

**Overview**
 Manager – Planning \& Business Solutions for Energy \& Projects vertical supports the execution and delivery of AIT’s Energy \& Projects (E\&P) solutions strategy within the IMEA region. The role focuses on commercial execution, customer support, operational coordination, and product deployment, contributing to sustainable and profitable growth in line with regional and corporate objectives.
   

  

 The Manager partners closely with the Director – Energy \& Projects, regional leadership, and cross‑functional teams to support business development initiatives, ensure operational excellence, and maintain strong relationships with customers and service providers involved in complex Energy and Project logistics solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate end‑to‑end execution of Energy, Oil \& Gas, and Project Cargo movements across India \& Middle East region, ensuring safety, regulatory compliance, and on‑time delivery.
* Serve as the operational and technical subject‑matter expert for Energy \& Project cargo, including OOG, breakbulk, modules, skids, and engineered movements supporting upstream, midstream, and downstream projects.
* Manage routing, carrier selection, vessel planning, equipment configuration, permits, surveys, and method‑of‑transport execution in alignment with approved SOPs, HSE plans, and EPC requirements.
* Coordinate carriers, heavy‑haul and SPMT providers, ports, terminals, yards, and third‑party service providers to ensure capacity availability, service continuity, and effective risk mitigation in Oil \& Gas environments.
* Monitor shipment‑ and project‑level cost performance, supporting margin integrity and compliance with approved commercial frameworks and customer contractual requirements.
* Support tender execution for Energy \& Oil \& Gas projects through operational feasibility assessments, execution methodology reviews, and pricing inputs within defined authority limits.
* Collaborate with regional pricing and procurement teams to validate rates, equipment availability, and market conditions, sharing intelligence on carrier capacity and cost drivers within the Energy sector.
* Track operational KPIs related to safety, schedule adherence, cost control, and execution quality, implementing corrective actions for deviations.
* Act as a first‑level operational escalation point for complex, high‑risk, or cross‑border Energy \& Project shipments, including shutdowns, critical\-path cargo, and remote site deliveries.
* Ensure full compliance with HSE, DG, project QA/QC standards, and customer‑specific Oil \& Gas and Energy project requirements.
* Collaborate with regional leadership, sales, engineering, and operations teams to improve execution capability, standardization, and delivery performance across Energy \& Projects programs.


**Qualifications**
* A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value!
* A strong work ethic with an appreciation for ownership, independence, accountability and autonomy in your role.
* Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently.
* Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture!


**Other Skills We Hope To See**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 8–12 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or project cargo, within Energy or Industrial Projects.
* Experience supporting P\&L performance, pricing, or commercial activities.
* Exposure to Air, Ocean, and Project logistics operations.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and geographies preferred.
* Strong coordination, communication, and problem‑solving skills.
* Process‑oriented with attention to detail and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrate a great deal of initiative and a strong hands\-on mentality
* High customer and service orientation
* High ability to work under pressure in a matrix environment and willingness to travel
* Demonstrates sound judgment and the ability to operate effectively in complex, high‑risk environments.


**About AIT Worldwide**
 AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps its customers grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure raw materials, components, and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the America’s\-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, food, government, healthcare, high\-tech, industrial and life sciences. Backed by scalable, user\-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door\-to\-door deliveries via sea, air, ground, and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 100 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe, India, and North America, AIT’s full\-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services. Learn more about AIT Worldwide Logistics, our culture and core values in action here .
   

  

**What AIT Can Offer You**
 In addition to base compensation, AIT offers a growing suite of competitive benefits to help our teammates realize their full financial, well\-being, personal and professional potential.
   

  

**AIT Worldwide Logistics Benefits Available Across All Global Markets**
* Vacation/holiday time
* Global employee support program
* Mindfulness tools
* Professional development
* Company events and gatherings
* Five paid volunteer hours through our AIT Cares program


 Our competitive employee benefits packages may vary by region and country.

These tent\-pole events play a critical role in driving customer acquisition, engagement, and long\-term growth for Amazon in MENA.
   

  

 We are looking for a Program Manager to support the planning, execution, and performance tracking of these large\-scale events. This role will work closely with the Events team to coordinate key milestones, monitor event performance, and ensure strong cross\-functional alignment across Marketing, Category, Finance, Operations, and Tech teams.
   

  

 The Program Manager will play an important role in maintaining operational excellence across the events program. This includes tracking deliverables across multiple stakeholders, supporting in performance analysis, identifying trends in customer and business metrics, and helping translate insights into actionable recommendations. The role requires strong organization, analysis, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 A successful candidate will be highly analytical and data\-driven, structured in their approach to problem solving, and comfortable working with data to understand performance drivers. They will demonstrate strong ownership of their workstreams, clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to dive deep to support the team in delivering high\-impact customer events.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Event Program Coordination: Support the planning and execution of High Velocity Events across UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt by tracking key workstreams, milestones, and dependencies. Maintain structured tracking mechanisms to ensure teams are aligned on timelines, deliverables, and event readiness. Identify risks early, escalate blockers where required, and support the resolution of operational issues to keep programs on track.
* Performance Monitoring \& Analysis: Analyze event performance across key business metrics using Excel and internal tools. Work with large datasets, build reusable templates, and support recurring reporting to monitor performance throughout the event lifecycle. Conduct structured analysis to identify performance drivers, highlight gaps vs. plan, and provide data\-backed insights to inform decision\-making. SQL experience is a plus.
* Reporting \& Insights: Create and maintain performance dashboards, reports, and event recaps to provide visibility on key metrics and outcomes. Support the preparation of leadership updates by synthesizing insights and highlighting key trends.
* Process Improvement \& Automation: Partner with Business Intelligence teams to improve reporting processes, test new tools, and support automation of recurring analyses. Help document best practices and continuously improve internal event processes and playbooks.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across Marketing, Category, Finance, Operations, and Tech to ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables. Facilitate clear communication across teams, track follow\-ups, and support governance mechanisms through structured updates and reporting.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
* Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision\-making processes
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of databases (querying and analyzing) such as SQL, MYSQL, and ETL Manager and working with large data sets
* 1\. Experience working in e\-commerce, retail, analytics, or other fast\-paced operational environments.
* 3\. Experience building dashboards, reporting tools, or automated tracking mechanisms to support program performance.
* 4\. Experience working with cross\-functional teams across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* 5\. Experience supporting large programs, campaigns, or operational initiatives with multiple stakeholders.

* 5\+ years in affiliate or partnerships at a gaming or crypto operator, operator\-side only, not agency or network.

data.raw_snippet:

 Canonical's largest software products are built by multiple teams working togeth
data.jd_text:
This is the general track for Engineering Director at Canonical, apply here if you are confident to run a project which spans teams and time zones, hiring and managing engineering managers and staff engineers.
   

  

 Canonical's largest software products are built by multiple teams working together under a single director of engineering. Once you have passed the first round of interviews we will discuss specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.
   

  

 We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering directors set the pace and the direction to help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
   

  

 Even though this is a senior management position, managing managers, we expect Engineering Directors to be outstanding developers with the confidence to lead by example across the full range of activities in their teams. You need to understand what great code looks like in the language and genre of your product \- whether that is a web service, or a system daemon, or a desktop application, or a distributed system. You'll need to know how to drive testing and benchmarking to improve the clarity in your teams around quality and performance. You'll also need to be confident to set and defend high expectations of work ethic, consistency, focus and learning.
   

  

 We have director level roles across a wide range of engineering domains, including:
   

  

* Python and Golang
* C / C\+\+ / Rust
* Data infrastructure
* HTML / CSS / JavaScript / Typescript / React
* Flutter
* Distro packaging and systems
* SAAS and web microservices
* Kernel
* Servers
* Graphics, Browser and Desktop
* Silicon enablement and embedded devices
* Product Security


 If your domain of expertise isn't listed above, yet you feel it's relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.
   

  

 Location: The role is remote, with positions available in all time zones. It includes a requirement for global travel for twice per year, for trips up to two weeks long.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Lead multiple teams of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
* Develop your engineering managers and maintain Canonical culture
* Hire staff level engineers for specific roles like performance and quality
* Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
* Identify and measure indicators of team health and productivity
* Ensure rounded delivery including community participation and docs
* Implement disciplined engineering processes and defend them
* Set and measure progress against benchmark goals for speed and efficiency
* Represent your product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
* Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
* Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
* Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
* Collaborate with leads for related or dependent products


 What we're looking for in you
   

  

* An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
* Extensive management experience and confidence to set high expectations
* Outstanding Linux based software engineering track record
* Drive and a track record of going above\-and\-beyond expectations
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Public speaking and presentation skills
* A love of developing and growing people and a track record of it
* Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring software developers
* Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
* Well\-organised, self\-starting and able to deliver to schedule
* Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
* You have advanced expertise in your own domain
* You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
* You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
* You have a demonstrated drive for continual learning
* Builds trust, relationships and confidence
* Result\-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
* Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each


**Additional Skills We Value**
* Experience in a developer advocacy or community role
* Open source community engagement and leadership
* Ops and system administration experience
* Performance engineering and security experience


 What we offer you
   

  

 We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance\-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
   

  

* Distributed work environment with twice\-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

In addition to t
data.jd_text:
The Head of Construction/Construction Director oversees the full execution of the high\-rise development projects in Abu Dhabi and Dubai, from pre\-construction through to handover, acting as the key link between the project site, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders. In addition to technical and construction oversight, the role assumes broad project management responsibilities to ensure timely delivery, budget control, quality assurance, and alignment with MERED’s ultra\-luxury standards.
   





  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Act as the Client’s Point of contact on\-site, representing the company in all day\-to\-day project operations, stakeholder communications, technical decisions, and program management—ensuring seamless execution of the company’s development vision.
* Take responsibility for the execution and monitoring of the project master schedule, overseeing critical path activities and proactively resolving bottlenecks across all trades and work fronts.
* Lead all site\-level decision\-making, interfacing daily with the Consultant and Contractor, while aligning with the strategic objectives of the Executive Management team.
* Coordinate and chair all weekly progress meetings, technical coordination meetings, and task force sessions with internal and external parties; follow preparation of comprehensive MOMs, trackers, and follow\-ups to ensure accountability and implementation.
* Ensure that all procurement, long lead items, shop drawings, and authority approvals are aligned with the schedule and proactively track their timelines with the planning department to avoid execution delays.
* Review and assess contractor’s programs, lookahead plans, recovery schedules, and mitigation plans; reject or revise plans that do not meet MERED's standards or fail to support critical milestones.
* Monitor and supervise site works for full scope disciplines including:
+ Soil Investigation.
+ Enabling Works.
+ Structural: Sequencing, rebar installation, slab formwork, PT works, cast\-in items.
+ Architectural: Blockworks, waterproofing, screeding, ceiling frameworks, partitions, stone and tile installations.
+ Façade: System panels, brackets, brackets coordination with MEP penetrations and PT zones, balcony closures.
+ ID: Joinery, veneer mockups, lighting details, finishing tolerances, and detail verifications.
+ MEP: Shaft coordination, riser alignment, containment readiness, T\&C planning and authority inspections.

* Take charge of all government authority coordination (DDA, DEWA, Civil Defense, DM, RTA), ensuring that submissions, site inspections, approvals, and NOCs are prepared and executed on time.
* Maintain direct oversight of design coordination activities, ensuring all site conditions, RFI responses, and consultant instructions are technically reviewed, confirmed, and closed in collaboration with design managers and consultants.
* Represent the Developer in all commercial and contractual coordination together with commercial team by:
+ Evaluating technical claims, cost implications, and time extension requests.
+ Providing technical input to Contracts/Legal for variation orders, claims rebuttals, and scope clarifications.
+ Assessing additional work justifications and holding the Contractor accountable for scope performance.

* Take full leadership of QA/QC implementation:
+ Approve method statements and ITPs.
+ Review NCRs and ensure rectification with zero recurrence.
+ Verify material submittals, shop drawing accuracy, and as\-built records.

* Manage construction digital tools and systems, ensuring workflows, WIRs, MIRs, and document reviews are completed accurately, with continuous system training and performance follow\-up.
* Support planning department for internal weekly reporting to Executive Management:
+ Progress dashboards, milestone tracking, risk registers, productivity comparisons, and KPI compliance reviews.

* Oversee cost control interfaces with the commercial team by tracking site quantities, abortive works, unexecuted scope, and opportunities for value engineering or savings through optimization.
* Support the tendering process by preparing and coordinating technical evaluations, organizing site visits for bidders, reviewing PTC’s, technical submissions and providing input on contractor selection in coordination with the Commercial and Design teams.
* Support the Marketing team by preparing monthly construction progress updates, facilitating site readiness for content creation activities (photoshoots, videography, walkthroughs), and coordinating materials that reflect the company’s culture, particularly in health, safety, and environmental standards.
* Drive logistics and construction phasing strategies including crane operations, platform reconfigurations, hoist planning, material laydown, storage areas, and emergency access.
* Coordinate with the Contractor and Engineer to uphold a high standard of HSE culture across the project by leading weekly HSE\-focused site walks, enforcing compliance with UAE regulations and MERED’s internal safety policies, and ensuring that all activities reflect a clean, safe, and well\-managed construction environment.
* Spearhead initiatives to elevate site culture:
+ Ensure strict housekeeping compliance.
+ Maintain site readiness for walkthroughs.

* Facilitate pre\-handover activities including testing and commissioning, authority handover, DLP coordination, and unit inspections aligned with project branding and customer satisfaction goals.


 Requirements
   


**Required Qualifications**



* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or architecture.
* 15–20 years of experience in high\-rise construction, including luxury residential towers (experience with offices and hotels is a plus).
* Relevant experience in high\-rise construction projects in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
* Verifiable experience working for Tier 1 contractors or developers.
* Understanding of FIDIC contracts and construction contract administration.
* Knowledge of construction planning and phasing.
* Appreciation for customer care and commitment to handing over projects with a customer\-centric approach.
* Understanding of RERA inspections and approvals for Dubai projects, and relevant authority regulations for Abu Dhabi projects.
* Strong technical knowledge in structural, MEP, façade, ID, and authority regulations.
* Proficient in project management tools (Primavera, MS Project), AutoCAD, and document control systems.








**Preferred Qualifications**



* Professional certification if applicable, PMP certification or equivalent project management training.
* Experience with Dubai development regulations and authorities (DDA, DEWA, RTA, etc.).
* Exposure to design management or contractor\-side execution is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of sustainability certifications (LEED) in construction execution, if applicable.
* Industry\-recognized professional whose expertise and reputation are valued by contractors.



  





**Skills and Competencies**



* Strong leadership and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent coordination and conflict resolution skills.
* Meticulous attention to detail and organizational discipline.
* Proactive problem\-solver with a results\-oriented mindset.
* Comfortable managing complex teams and high\-pressure timelines.
* Fluent in English; knowledge of Russian or Arabic is an asset.



 ·
   




 Benefits
   

* Competitive salary package.
* Annual flight ticket allowance.
* Performance discretionary bonus.
* Comprehensive health insurance.
* Employment visa.

* Demonstrated ability to generate new business and maintain long\-term client relationships.

 Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.  Ideal candidate should have strong experience in monitoring costs, schedule, manpower and quality to ensure a smooth handover, while also being able to deal with clients directly. A degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering is required.

1. Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable; Contract Management of size of AED 100 Mi; Staff management of 200 staff; Energy management knowledge; P\&L Management.

 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. * Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments

* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

 Soft Skills \& Competencies

* Initiative \& Problem\-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem\-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on the method of engagement (employee or freelancer).
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to build an inclusive, diverse and non\-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

data.jd_text:
The College of Engineering (CEN) at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applicants for the position of the Head of the Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering (CHBE) starting Fall 2027\. The college is seeking a visionary academic leader with the responsibilities of ensuring smooth and successful operation and sustainable development of the department.
   

  

 The candidate for the position must hold earned degrees, including a doctorate, in chemical engineering or a related field. The candidate must have demonstrated leadership in research, as evidenced by her/his outstanding publication record. In addition, a demonstrated record of excellence in teaching, and in academic and relevant professional services is required. The selected individual will have the opportunity to develop and articulate a vision and long\-range plan for the department in teaching and in research strategy that embodies the relevant areas that are vital to the department and the region. Special consideration will be given to candidates with a clear vision and achievable goals that are in line with the college’s and university’s strategic plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate must be a dynamic, collaborative, visionary and innovative individual with demonstrated leadership experience that can promote the continued advancement of the department. He/she is expected to have strong communication skills to effectively engage with a wide variety of constituents within and outside the university. His/her leadership style should include positive attitude, transparency, integrity, trust, fairness, promptness and collegiality. In addition to the general and wide responsibilities of the department head position, as partially outlined in the
 *Faculty Handbook* 
 , the selected applicant will be required to:
   

  

* provide effective leadership with well\-defined plans to nurture and elevate the standard of the department, accompanied with the development of short\-term and long\-term strategies in alignment with the strategic plans of the college and the university
* ensure high\-quality teaching as well as holistic development of the students, using approaches such as technology supported delivery, problem\-based learning, and other cutting\-edge trends in engineering education, in addition to leading the continuous improvement of the curriculum
* facilitate the conduct of innovative and cutting\-edge research of high\-quality and impact and promote multidisciplinary research with the optimal use of research funds and research facilities
* empower, mentor, promote, inspire and support faculty and staff to develop and sustain excellence in teaching, research and service
* foster a positive culture of innovation and entrepreneurship among faculty and students
* improve continuously teaching, research and service through benchmarking
* lead the department in achieving student recruitment goals by establishing and implementing recruitment plans for undergraduate and graduate students
* enrich the students’ experience via enhanced services, exchange visits, invited speakers, field trips, student clubs, professional certifications, competitions, conferences, etc.
* secure full\-time and internship positions and provide undergraduate research experience to the students
* participate in outreach activities, including maintaining ties and collaborations with alumni, industry, government, advisory boards, other university units and community members, and maintaining involvement in local and international professional organizations
* advertise locally and publicly the achievements and expertise of the faculty, staff and students of the department through web, newsletters and media exposure to enhance the academic reputation of the program
* collect data systematically and continuously from the department to plan and execute informed decisions
* ensure and increase diversity and equity in faculty hiring and student recruitment
* maintain and actively promote a positive, safe, transparent, fair, open, respectful, collegial working environment at the department, college and university
* interact and communicate effectively with individual faculty, staff and students (and parents) on a range of professional and personal issues
* represent the faculty and staff and convey their needs to the college’s and university’s administration.
* oversee the department’s operations including scheduling, advising, registration, lab preparations, budget allocation, compliance and risk management, etc.
* review and coordinate faculty course releases, sabbaticals and leave without pay requests
* conduct fair faculty and staff annual evaluations and provide effective feedback
* evaluate faculty and staff for promotion and/or rolling contract decisions
* lead and manage accreditation visits
* performing other duties as needed or assigned by the Dean


 Applicants should fill out an application form and upload the required documents (PDF) using the following \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cen/empapp/apply.php?p\=CHE\-DH\-26\-01");"\>link. The required documents are a cover letter and a detailed curriculum vitae (including a teaching statement, a research statement, vision and goals for the department, list of courses that can be taught or were taught, and names of at least three references who would be willing to write letters of recommendation). Positions are open until filled. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

 The Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering has approximately 200 undergraduate students, 15 graduate students, 12 full\-time faculty and 3 lab instructors. Students and faculty represent very diverse backgrounds and nationalities; approximately 90 nationalities are present on campus. The department offers a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, a Bachelor of Science in Chemical and Biological Engineering, and a Master of Science in Chemical Engineering.
   

  

 AUS is located in the Emirate of Sharjah (about 15 km from Dubai). AUS is an independent, not\-for\-profit, coeducational university, serving more than 5,700 students. Further information can be obtained here.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education's Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\. The Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering offered by the College of Engineering is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("http://www.abet.org/");"\>http://www.abet.org/.
