data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that Country’s Corporate Bank Business is optimally managed with the appropriate levels of co\-ordination between the constituent parts of the unit. This includes ensuring that, revenue potential is realized in a cost effective, low risk manner. The target client portfolio is developed in line with QNB’s stated strategic intent and, maximum revenue potential of relationship officers is realized via effective coaching, training and communication.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective departmental/ unit heads and monitor exercise of the same
* Implement the bank’s approved strategy / plan to facilitate achievement of related short and long term business goals in the most effective and efficient manner.
* Oversee the development and subsequent implementation of annual plans by the individual departments / functions comprising Corporate Banking to ensure achievement of pre\-set targets / objectives, including but not limited to business growth and expansion.
* Approve / amend Key Performance Indicators for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement of the Corporate Banking Division and systematic monitoring of their achievements in terms of assets and liabilities.
* Manage the development and subsequent implementation of market best practices across all activities / operations comprising the Corporate and Institution Banking Department to promote efficiencies in work processes, ultimately resulting in increased customer satisfaction.
* Review / analyse the Corporate and Institution Banking Department management accounts (comprising the balance sheet, income statement along with the budgeted figures) on a monthly basis and positively address adverse variances noted with the respective departmental / function heads.
* Observes and promotes cost consciousness and efficiency, and enhance productivity, to minimize costs, avoid wastes, and optimize benefits for the bank
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure the provision of value added corporate products and services to existing / potential corporate banking customers who seek banking relationships with the bank.
* Endeavour to enhance, maintain and deepen relationships with existing corporate customer base, as well as building new relationships. Ensure, by monitoring the performance of the country FI / GSF / GTB resource, that the FI customer base is developed in accordance with approved country/regional strategy for FI’s / GTB and GSF.
* Oversee the implementation and constant enhancement of the overall customer service culture within Corporate Banking team.
* Approve Service Level Agreements with other branch divisions/ departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time, which will also help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Maintain and enhance relationships with Central Bank / other regulators and professional firms as appropriate. Ensure the promotion of QNB’s footprint and product and service offering through professional and other relevant forums.
* Support the local development of GAM accounts where appropriate.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Responsible for establishing and maintaining sound internal control environments across Corporate Banking team.

data.jd_text:
**This role is based in Muscat, Oman.** 




  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a Project Manager \- Fiber Rollout (Oman) to manage and control the nationwide rollout of fiber optic backbone infrastructure across Oman by overseeing OSP fiber deployment, civil works, shelters, ILA sites, and electro\-mechanical implementation, ensuring delivery is completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with approved technical, regulatory, safety, and quality standards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Permit \& Regulatory Coordination** 



* Coordinate and monitor excavation permits, PTW requirements, and regulatory approvals in line with project timelines.
* Ensure all legal, permit, and regulatory documentation is complete, accurate, and properly archived for operational handover.
* Represent ZOI in meetings with external authorities, municipalities, and stakeholders across Oman as required.



  





**Design Validation \& Quantity Control** 



* Review and validate route designs, site layouts, and implementation drawings to ensure constructibility and compliance with approved standards.
* Coordinate with contractors to optimize trenching routes, diversions, civil quantities, and electro\-mechanical scope without compromising quality.
* Maintain weekly comparison and control of BoM and BoQ across all links and sites against planned, in\-progress, and as\-built status.
* Review, validate, and control contractor payment certificates and identify any quantity or scope deviations.



  





**Contractor Governance \& Reporting** 



* Lead daily contractor meetings as required and mandatory weekly progress meetings to review delivery status and key issues.
* Prepare and maintain formal Minutes of Meeting (MoMs) for all contractor meetings and ensure proper documentation control.
* Maintain contractor\-wise RAID trackers covering risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
* Consolidate project data and prepare daily, weekly, and milestone\-based progress reports for management review.
* Maintain full project documentation covering execution records, approvals, inspections, acceptances, invoicing, and PO closure status.



  





**Project Controls \& Quality Assurance** 



* Apply project management controls, implementation standards, and quality benchmarks across all OSP and site rollout activities.
* Verify actual field conditions against reported contractor progress prior to milestone confirmation and invoice validation.
* Monitor and validate critical as\-built quantities and technical elements, including HDD sections, wadi crossings, pipeline crossings, and rock excavation.
* Ensure handover packages, as\-built documentation, and acceptance records are complete, accurate, and ready for Operations.



  





**Financial \& Delivery Control** 



* Track contractor scope, PO values, milestone achievement, and delivery progress against approved budgets and contractual commitments.
* Ensure contractor invoicing aligns with verified site progress, approved quantities, and contractual scope.
* Identify and escalate cost, quantity, and delivery variances that may impact project timelines or financial exposure.
* Support efficient utilization of materials, contractor resources, and site execution plans to optimize delivery performance and cost control.



  





**Education / Certifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is required.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in telecom infrastructure deployment, including OSP fiber rollout, site implementation, and backbone network projects.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in project management roles covering OSP fiber and/or site rollout scope.
* Minimum 4 years of experience in managing backbone OSP rollout projects.



  





**Knowledge / Technical Skills** 




  




* Strong knowledge of telecom infrastructure rollout within GCC markets; Oman experience in a similar role is strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of OSP fiber backbone deployment, civil works, shelters, ILA sites, and electro\-mechanical site implementation.
* Strong understanding of multi\-phase, multi\-contractor project environments and nationwide rollout governance.
* Familiarity with Oman\-wide NOC / PTW / excavation permit procedures, including work in Oil \& Gas / restricted zones.
* Strong knowledge of shelter sites, PoPs, fiber optic cable (FOC) routing, and related civil and electro\-mechanical design and implementation requirements.
* Hands\-on knowledge of acceptance testing, cable measurements, route/site handover documentation, and quality control processes.
* Strong project management, contractor management, reporting, communication, negotiation, and issue resolution skills.
* Proficiency in managing RAID logs, progress tracking, milestone validation, and contractor performance controls.

data.raw_snippet:

 Canonical's largest software products are built by multiple teams working togeth
data.jd_text:
This is the general track for Engineering Director at Canonical, apply here if you are confident to run a project which spans teams and time zones, hiring and managing engineering managers and staff engineers.
   

  

 Canonical's largest software products are built by multiple teams working together under a single director of engineering. Once you have passed the first round of interviews we will discuss specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.
   

  

 We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering directors set the pace and the direction to help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
   

  

 Even though this is a senior management position, managing managers, we expect Engineering Directors to be outstanding developers with the confidence to lead by example across the full range of activities in their teams. You need to understand what great code looks like in the language and genre of your product \- whether that is a web service, or a system daemon, or a desktop application, or a distributed system. You'll need to know how to drive testing and benchmarking to improve the clarity in your teams around quality and performance. You'll also need to be confident to set and defend high expectations of work ethic, consistency, focus and learning.
   

  

 We have director level roles across a wide range of engineering domains, including:
   

  

* Python and Golang
* C / C\+\+ / Rust
* Data infrastructure
* HTML / CSS / JavaScript / Typescript / React
* Flutter
* Distro packaging and systems
* SAAS and web microservices
* Kernel
* Servers
* Graphics, Browser and Desktop
* Silicon enablement and embedded devices
* Product Security


 If your domain of expertise isn't listed above, yet you feel it's relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.
   

  

 Location: The role is remote, with positions available in all time zones. It includes a requirement for global travel for twice per year, for trips up to two weeks long.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Lead multiple teams of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
* Develop your engineering managers and maintain Canonical culture
* Hire staff level engineers for specific roles like performance and quality
* Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
* Identify and measure indicators of team health and productivity
* Ensure rounded delivery including community participation and docs
* Implement disciplined engineering processes and defend them
* Set and measure progress against benchmark goals for speed and efficiency
* Represent your product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
* Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
* Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
* Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
* Collaborate with leads for related or dependent products


 What we're looking for in you
   

  

* An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
* Extensive management experience and confidence to set high expectations
* Outstanding Linux based software engineering track record
* Drive and a track record of going above\-and\-beyond expectations
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Public speaking and presentation skills
* A love of developing and growing people and a track record of it
* Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring software developers
* Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
* Well\-organised, self\-starting and able to deliver to schedule
* Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
* You have advanced expertise in your own domain
* You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
* You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
* You have a demonstrated drive for continual learning
* Builds trust, relationships and confidence
* Result\-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
* Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each


**Additional Skills We Value**
* Experience in a developer advocacy or community role
* Open source community engagement and leadership
* Ops and system administration experience
* Performance engineering and security experience


 What we offer you
   

  

 We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance\-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
   

  

* Distributed work environment with twice\-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events


**About Canonical**

**Job Purpose** 




  





 Head of Distribution is responsible for leading and managing the overall Retail Banking Distribution Network, including branches, sales channels, and distribution support functions. The role drives the strategic direction, performance, and profitability of retail distribution channels, ensuring effective customer acquisition, service delivery, and market expansion.
 



  





 The position ensures alignment between Retail Banking strategy, branch performance, and channel optimization while maintaining high standards of governance, operational efficiency, and customer experience across the distribution network.
 



  





**Key responsibilities of the role include:** 




  




* Development and execution of the Retail Distribution Strategy aligned with Retail Banking objectives.
* Driving sales performance, customer acquisition, and revenue growth across the branch network.
* Optimizing branch network footprint and multi\-channel distribution.
* Strengthening customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Ensuring strong governance, compliance, and Sharia adherence across all distribution activities.



  





  





**Main Tasks \& Accountabilities** 




  





**Distribution Strategy \& Business Growth** 




  




* sustainable growth within Retail Banking.
* Translate strategic objectives into clear distribution frameworks and execution plans across the branch network and sales channels.
* Ensure alignment between distribution strategy, market opportunities, and overall Retail Banking objectives.
* Continuously review and refine distribution approaches to ensure the organization remains competitive and responsive to market dynamics.



  





**Channel Optimization \& Network Management** 




  




* Lead and oversee the activities of Retail Banking sales and distribution channels.
* Ensure optimal utilization and coordination of distribution channels to support customer acquisition and service delivery.
* Develop and execute the branch network strategy, including expansion, relocation, consolidation, or optimization of branches where required.
* Monitor the overall effectiveness of the distribution network and identify opportunities to improve reach and efficiency.



  





**Operational Effectiveness \& Customer Experience** 




  




* Coordinate initiatives aimed at enhancing operational efficiency across distribution channels.
* Promote a culture focused on service quality and continuous improvement in customer experience.
* Support the implementation of initiatives that enhance the effectiveness and responsiveness of the distribution network.



  





**Stakeholder Engagement \& Governance** 




  




* Strengthen relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to support distribution effectiveness.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and governance standards across distribution activities.
* Facilitate coordination between distribution teams and other business units to ensure alignment between strategy and execution.



  





**Leadership Responsibilities** 




  




* Inspire and lead distribution teams towards high levels of performance and accountability.
* Build and sustain a high\-performing distribution organization through effective leadership and talent development.
* Foster strong working relationships across the organization to support business objectives and collaboration.
* Ensure that operational activities within the distribution network remain aligned with strategic priorities.



  





**Education Level** 




  




* Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Banking, Finance, Business Administration or related field



  





**Professional Qualifications** 




  




* Professional banking or leadership certifications (preferred)



  





**Work Experience** 




  




* Minimum 12–15 years of banking experience, with at least 8 years in Retail Banking distribution or sales leadership roles.
* Proven experience in managing branch networks and multi\-channel distribution.
* Strong track record in retail sales growth, customer acquisition, and deposit mobilization.
* Experience in strategic planning, distribution management, and business performance optimization.
* Sound knowledge of Oman retail banking market and competitive landscape.
* Knowledge of Islamic Banking and Sharia principles.
* Good understanding of CBO regulations and Oman banking environment.



  





  





**General Competencies** 




  




* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent strategic planning and execution skills.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Customer\-centric and performance\-driven mindset.
* High standards of integrity, governance, and compliance.

data.jd_text:
**JOB PURPOSE:** 




 To originate, manage, and grow a high‑quality corporate banking portfolio by developing deep client relationships, delivering strategic financial solutions, and coordinating with product partners across FAB. The role ensures strong risk management, portfolio quality, revenue growth, and adherence to CBO regulatory frameworks i.e., BM 1108, BM 1170 and all other regulatory circulars issued by CBO. The Director acts as a primary client advisor and portfolio owner, responsible for end‑to‑end execution on credit, onboarding, cross‑sell, and service delivery.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 



* **Client Relationship \& Portfolio Management:**
* Lead coverage for corporates and Business Banking clients, in country and across FAB network.
* Develop Account Plans, grow wallet share, enhance cross‑sell.
* Ensure portfolio monitoring, early‑warning identification, compliance with FAB’s credit risk appetite.
* Maintain credit quality and ensure all reviews, renewals, and covenants are completed.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Prepare Key Account Plans for clients.



  




* **Origination \& Deal Execution:**
* Identify, structure, and originate opportunities aligned with client needs.
* Prepare CIMs, term sheets, pricing proposals.
* Lead end‑to‑end execution with Credit, Risk, Legal, Ops, and product partners.
* Manage P\&L responsibility of the assigned portfolio, achieving targets within defined budget levels.



  




* **Risk Management \& Compliance:**
* Maintain strong credit discipline and covenant monitoring.
* Ensure AML/KYC compliance, periodic reviews, and regulatory adherence.
* Support internal/external audits, CBO examination, ORM, BCP, and internal compliance.
* Manage and ensure effective implementation of the business functional policies, procedures and controls covering all areas of assigned department activity so that all relevant procedural/legislative requirements, fulfilled while delivering a quality, cost\-effective service.



  




* **Collaboration with Product Partners/Sector Heads:**
* Work closely with GTx, Trade, Markets, Treasury, Corporate Finance, etc and all other product partners and sector heads/team.
* Drive cross‑sell revenue and support NTB onboarding.
* Promote digital adoption across FAB corporate channels.



  




* **Market \& Sector Intelligence:**
* Conduct sector analysis and provide insights into management.
* Track economic, sovereign, GRE, and market developments.



  




* **Operational Excellence:**
* Ensure documentation, KFS, account plans, and pipeline accuracy.
* Adhere to governance frameworks and DOA.



  




* **Day‑to‑Day Activities:**
* Manage daily client engagement and transactions end‑to‑end.
* Update CRM, MIS, LH pipeline trackers regularly.
* Assist in the preparation of timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit’s requirements, policies, and standards.
* Learning \& Development – Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Support ED/Coverage Head with portfolio and governance reports.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 




**Minimum Qualification:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Banking, Economics, Business, or similar
* MBA/Finance preferred.



**Minimum Experience:** 



* 5\+ years of experience in Corporate Banking or a similar area preferably managing client relationships.



  





**Knowledge, Skills, and Attributes:** 



* Strong understanding of corporate banking products and credit structuring.
* Familiarity with CBO frameworks including BM1108, BM1170, KYC/AML, KFS.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be primarily responsible for managing on a day\-to\-day basis a portfolio of existing and potential corporate customers to meet assigned financial targets of assigned country location. Incumbent is expected to develop and profitably manage banking relationships for business customers within their geographic territory or industry/customer portfolio. This position functions as the primary resource for extension of the full range of bank products and services applicable to the business customer. These will typically include credit and deposit services, as well as international transactions or other specialized services
   

  

 Main Duties
   

  

* Play a major role in the implementation of the strategies and plan to achieve all set volume, revenue and profit targets for the Corporate Banking function within the assigned country location and in accordance with QNB’s overall corporate budget and strategy.
* Come up consistently with business ideas to help boost revenues
* Develop Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement of the Corporate Banking Unit and monitor their achievements on periodic basis.
* Observes and promotes cost consciousness and efficiency, and enhance productivity, to minimize costs, avoid wastes, and optimize benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and adheres to QNB policies
* Develop and manage on a day\-to\-day basis potential corporate customers and assigned portfolio of existing customers to meet assigned financial and non\-financial targets in compliance with established QNB credit policies, procedures and standards.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with all related functions / units to achieve assigned goals / objectives.
* Support with appropriate direction of work and duties for the ARM and support with relevant training and support.
* Responsible for business development and origination as well as credit recommendations in favour of selected local and regional corporations
* Provide timely and accurate information to the Senior RM \& Head of Corporate \& Institutional Banking and head office regarding credit and compliance issues in local and regional markets.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required


 Education/Skills
   

  

* University graduate (Bachelor’s degree) preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics, Mathematics, or Business Administration (related field of study), Masters preferred
* Excellent oral and written communication skills (including report writing) in English. Arabic, French or applicable local language highly desirable.
* Ideal candidate should possess relevant relationship management experience built on sound credit background, with 10 years additional relevant banking experience
* Good knowledge of the banking and commercial environment of the country.
* Ability to solve problems and adopt a hands\-on role to meet financial targets.
* Computer literate able to compose own correspondences/ reports using bank standard applications.
* Good oral and written communication skills both in local and English language.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

**Job Description**
 Job description:
   

  

 What to consider before applying? The role is open for UAE Nationals.
 **About Us**
 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.
   

  

**Line Of Service Overview**
 Our Deals practice helps organisations navigate complex transactions, from mergers and acquisitions to restructuring and strategic investments. We deliver insights and solutions that enable clients to create, protect, and realise value throughout the deal lifecycle.
   

  

**Business Unit Overview**
 The Delivering Deal Value (DDV) team is part of Deals Strategy \& Operations. We focus on operational integration and value creation across the transaction lifecycle, including pre\-deal due diligence, synergy assessment, carve\-outs, integration planning, and post\-deal performance improvement. Our goal is to help clients unlock maximum value from their transactions.
   

  

**How You’ll Contribute**
 As a Deals Senior Associate in Delivering Deal Value, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Support the preparation of operational due diligence reports and integration assessments
* Assist clients with carve\-out planning, Day One readiness, and post\-merger integration activities
* Contribute to technology PMO support for deals, focusing on execution planning, risk management, and governance
* Identify potential synergies, risks, and integration issues and evaluate their impact on deal timelines and functional readiness
* Develop structured, analytical, and compelling client deliverables and reports
* Support business development efforts including proposals, capability building, and client presentations
* Research and analyse market and company\-level technology insights to inform recommendations
* Collaborate closely with team members to ensure timely and quality outcomes


**What You’ll Bring**
* 2\+ years of experience in M\&A, consulting, or advisory roles within a large organisation
* Proven experience in operational or commercial due diligence; exposure to carve\-outs and integrations is a plus
* Familiarity with technology PMO or implementation within deal or transformation environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to extract insights and understand business drivers
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and collaboration tools such as Office 365
* Self\-starter with ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines
* Familiarity with digital and technology\-enabled solutions to enhance delivery
* Your flexibility to travel 40%–60% of the time. This means we may require you to work away from your base office location on a regular basis and frequent overnight stays may be required. data.jd_text:
Job Title:Lead Network Architect
 



 Location:Dubai (On\-site)
 



**Role Summary:** 




 We are seeking a senior Network Architecture Leader to define, own, and continuously improve the end\-to\-end target network architecture that enables business growth and a high\-quality user and customer experience.This is a strategy, design and design\-authority position (not hands\-on delivery).
 



**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 




 Must Have:
 


* You should have architecture\-level experience across most of the following (not necessarily daily operations today, but enough depth to design, challenge, and standardize):
* Cisco Meraki Wi\-Fi
* Cisco Catalyst switching
* Cisco SD\-WAN
* Cisco ISE (NAC/RADIUS integration patterns and scale considerations)
* Fortinet /Cisco firewalls
* SASE solutions at scale (design \+ remediation \+ operating model with Security)
* Typically, 10\+ years in enterprise networking, plus 5\+ years architecture ownership in large distributed environments (retail/logistics a plus).
* Proven ability to define target architectures that scale across hundreds of sites and multiple countries.
* Strong documentation discipline (clear HLD/LLD, standards, decision records, executive\-ready packs).
* Ability to influence and align multiple teams (Security, Ops, Engineering, PMO) and drive decisions.
* Practical understanding of automation and how to govern it (Terraform exposure required).



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience running architecture review boards / design authorities (beyond presenting into forums).
* Cloud networking depth (Azure/AWS/GCP connectivity patterns, private connectivity, hub\-and\-spoke).
* Strong observability mindset (telemetry/logging standards, SLOs for network services).
* Certifications (CCNP/CCIE, vendor SD\-WAN/SASE/Fortinet), optional.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 IFZA Dubai is the most dynamic and truly international Free Zone Community in the UAE, optimizing the country's strategic location and world\-class infrastructure. We provide easy, reliable, and fast company formation services through our network of Professional Partners and Government Authorities.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The IT Project Coordinator supports IT projects by maintaining accurate documentation, records, and administrative controls throughout the project lifecycle. The role focuses on ensuring that all project\-related information is properly recorded, tracked, and archived to support operational continuity, reporting, and audit requirements.
   

  

 The IT Project Coordinator does not hold decision\-making authority. All project governance, approvals, prioritization, and strategic decisions remain under the responsibility of the Project Manager. The role operates in a support capacity, ensuring disciplined documentation and coordination in line with established project management practices.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Maintaining complete, accurate, and up\-to\-date project documentation across all IT projects
* Creating, updating, and archiving project records including plans, schedules, registers, approvals, and correspondence
* Ensuring version control and proper document classification in accordance with IT and PMO standards
* Recording project decisions, actions, and outcomes as approved by the Project Manager/IT Manager
* Updating Zoho Projects, timelines, and task lists strictly based on Project Manager direction
* Scheduling project meetings and accurately recording and distributing meeting minutes and action items
* Compiling project status reports using approved input from IT Team Leads and the Project Manager
* Maintaining risk, issue, dependency, and assumption logs as identified by the Project Manager/IT Manager
* Coordinating with the Procurement department to support project\-related purchasing activities
* Preparing and maintaining procurement\-related documentation such as requisitions, approvals, and delivery records, and vendor management
* Tracking procurement status and timelines and reporting updates to the Project Manager
* Supporting audits and reviews by providing complete, traceable, and audit\-ready documentation
* Operating closely with IT teams, Procurement, Finance, and other internal departments as required
* Performing other IT\-related duties as assigned by Management


****Requirements:****
* Full English Proficiency is required
* 1\-2 years’ experience in project coordination (ITPM is a plus)
* Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Strong technical knowledge covering General IT, Network, systems etc.
* Strong working knowledge of project management tools such as Zoho Projects, ClickUp, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or equivalent platforms
* Ability to manage multiple tasks priorities in a structured, deadline\-driven environment


**Benefits**
* 24 annual leave days
* Annual flight home
* Life insurance plan
* Medical insurance plan (with the option to upgrade at your own cost)
* Bonus scheme (in relevant departments)
* Invitations to participate in various company functions, staff events, and department team building events
* Opportunities to learn, develop and grow with the organization

data.jd_text:
Job Position: Project Supervisor
   

  

 Reports to: Projects Engineer and Projects Manager
   

  

 Job Objectives:
   

  

 The Projects Supervisor is responsible for onsite project coordination/activities/supervision within an assigned location. The function is also responsible for ensuring proper technical/quality/timeline scope performance standards and metrics relating to timely completion of projects. Develop and implement detailed project work plans (in line with project work schedule) and review as appropriate to meet project needs and requirements. Identify construction related project risks to be resolved through consistent monitoring. Close onsite visits and coordinate with workers to ensure the continuous flow of work.
   

  

 Responsibilities and duties:
   

  

* Prepares the detailed site Work Plan (WP) together with the Projects Manager (PM); Projects Engineer (PE), Projects Coordinator (PC) and Projects Planning Engineer (PPE) in line with the project work schedule.
* Prepares a weekly progress report to be submitted to the PM, PE and PPE.
* Organizes the installation works on site in line with the WP and makes the necessary adjustments if needed.
* Has a good technical knowledge about the works to be done. Has the WP adjusted in line with technical challenges and if necessary, gets assistance from the PE technical team and PMO.
* Instructs the teams on site in line with the real site requirements.
* Gets the Specialist Supervisor (SS) when required for different activities at the required time.
* Critical when it comes to quality (both technically and aesthetically).
* Responsible of the site HSE and workers' compliance with Adearest and client safety standard.
* Organizes toolbox talks.
* Takes the responsibility on the materials and tools shipped to site.
* Discusses with PC whether special equipment (cranes, scissor, lift, etc.) is required.
* Serves as the link between the PE and the Specialist Supervisor (SS).
* Efficient use of company assets and tools.
* Coordinates site activities with main contractor and sub\-contractors.
* Resolves site issues with main contractor and sub\-contractors. Brings up unresolved site issues to the PE \& PM immediately without delay to find a solution.


 Years of Experience:
   

  

* Minimum of 3 years related experience in project management \& MEP Contracting \& EPC Companies.
* Strong experience in Refrigeration/Cold store insulation.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




  





 The Architect plays a key role in bringing our brands to life across new store developments, renovations, and retrofit projects. This role translates business needs and brand standards into spaces that are visually compelling, practical, compliant, and aligned with the intended customer experience.
 



  





 Working across the full architectural journey, from concept through to construction, the Architect combines design thinking, technical expertise, and stakeholder collaboration to deliver environments that meet both operational and commercial goals. Each project is an opportunity to enhance the guest experience while ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and in line with regulatory and brand expectations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Develop architectural design solutions for new store developments, renovations, remodels, and retrofit projects across multiple F\&B and retail brands
* Translate business requirements and brand standards into functional layouts, demarcation plans, and design documentation
* Conduct site visits and prepare measured survey drawings to support design development and project scoping
* Produce accurate drawings ensuring compliance with brand guidelines, local regulations, safety standards, accessibility requirements, and MEP coordination
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and coordinate with external partners to ensure alignment and delivery
* Manage multiple design tasks and ensure timely delivery in line with budgets, timelines, and SLAs
* Utilize architectural software (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, 3ds Max) to develop design outputs
* Track project progress and maintain updates through PMO tools
* Apply design\-led problem\-solving to improve functionality, efficiency, and user experience
* Propose value engineering solutions to optimize costs while maintaining design quality
* Ensure design outcomes align with business, operational, and commercial requirements
* Support construction activities through design clarifications, adjustments, and material reviews
* Identify opportunities to enhance guest and customer experience through effective spatial planning
* Stay updated on industry trends, building regulations, and design technologies



  





**Education and Experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture is required; Master’s is an advantage
* 3–5 years of experience as an Architect or Architectural Designer
* Experience in retail, hospitality, F\&B, or commercial store design
* Strong exposure to store layouts, customer flow, and space optimization
* Knowledge of building regulations, safety standards, and construction practices
* Experience working across multiple projects with cross\-functional stakeholders



  





**Skills and Competencies** 




  




* Strong architectural design and space planning capability
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design tools (AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, etc.)
* Solid understanding of building codes, materials, and construction methods
* Effective communication and stakeholder coordination
* Strong organization, prioritization, and attention to detail
* Problem\-solving mindset with sound judgment
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment
* Commercial awareness in delivering practical and cost\-effective solutions

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 The Emerging Country Network Topology Planning team is looking for a talented Network Planning Manager who will create solutions to optimize multi\-year and multi\-echelon network topology design, along with Supply Chain planning and Capacity design processes for new country expansion. Team scope includes emerging countries Long term Network Topology and strategic planning for Mexico, Brazil, Australia, Middle East, Turkey, South Africa, Singapore and new countries. As a team player you have an opportunity to work with some of the best Supply Chain professionals, Tech teams, Worldwide Engineers, Operations Managers, Finance partners, and business leaders across the continents to design optimal Supply Chain network solutions with an objective to solve the conflicting objectives and achieve best customer experience in the most cost efficient way. This role requires working with cross\-functional teams across the countries to jointly define requirements, develop FC (Fulfillment Center) topology and network solutions, and manage the timelines for all current and future projects. In addition, the role also involves working closely with Global Engineering Services, Design Engineers, PMO and tech teams to Optimize capacity creation and expand emerging countries Fulfillment Centers network. This position involves regular communication with senior management on status, risks/opportunities, and daily change control management. Cross\-team coordination, project management, and executive interaction skills are essential.
   

  

 This position requires strong stakeholders management, advanced critical thinking skills and the ability to navigate in fast paced environment. Successful candidates will be adept at diving deep through various information sources, and working closely with engineering teams, technology partners, local / regional operations, and finance teams to rapidly iterate and deliver solutions. This position requires working across a variety of teams to drive long\-term strategic initiatives and best practices adoption.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead Network planning and Capacity design projects working with cross\-functional teams focused on the Network expansion that meet cost optimization and speed acceleration goals.
* Coordinate and gather requirements from multiple partner teams to develop long term solution for next 3\-5 years planning horizon.
* Communicate and drive long term initiatives, actively work to remove bottlenecks and create scalable mechanisms and use Supply Chain knowledge to influence process enhancements.
* Effectively influence stakeholders without having direct authority. Drive clear, precise, and regular communication with stakeholders to include ongoing project/program status via monthly and quarterly planning reviews.
* Proactively identify gaps and opportunities in the process while partnering with established markets teams to benchmark the best practices to drive implementation and adoption for emerging countries.
* Contribute to mid to long\-term Capacity design, process standardization and development of innovative solution for new and existing emerging countries.
* Around 25% annual travel to respective countries to connect with local partners and learn the local operations.


**About The Team**
 The Emerging Country Long term Network Topology and Supply Chain Planning team works to optimize multi\-year and multi\-echelon network topology strategy, along with Supply Chain planning processes for nine emerging countries. Team scope includes Network planning of Mexico, Brazil, Australia, Middle East (AE, KSA, EG), Turkey, South Africa and Singapore, with additional new countries to come with further international expansion.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Network Capacity planning and Long term planning
* 5\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
* Strong Verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree Supply Chain Management or Operation Management
* High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
* Experience with Six Sigma/Lean, Statistical data analysis, network modeling and Operational Excellence
* Ability to write SQL/Python queries and use BI Tools like Tableau/Power BI.
* Knowledge of how a fulfillment center, and transportation network is designed and operated
* Demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and tactically in a high\-energy, fast\-paced environment
* Strong bias for action; ability to juggle multiple competing priorities and create a sense of urgency in a fast\-paced, and dynamic environment

data.jd_text:
What to consider before applying? The role is open for UAE Nationals.
   

  

**About Us**
 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.
   

  

**Line Of Service Overview**
 Our Deals practice helps organisations navigate complex transactions, from mergers and acquisitions to restructuring and strategic investments. We deliver insights and solutions that enable clients to create, protect, and realise value throughout the deal lifecycle.
   

  

**Business Unit Overview**
 The Delivering Deal Value (DDV) team is part of Deals Strategy \& Operations. We focus on operational integration and value creation across the transaction lifecycle, including pre\-deal due diligence, synergy assessment, carve\-outs, integration planning, and post\-deal performance improvement. Our goal is to help clients unlock maximum value from their transactions.
   

  

**How You’ll Contribute**
 As a Deals Senior Associate in Delivering Deal Value, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Support the preparation of operational due diligence reports and integration assessments
* Assist clients with carve\-out planning, Day One readiness, and post\-merger integration activities
* Contribute to technology PMO support for deals, focusing on execution planning, risk management, and governance
* Identify potential synergies, risks, and integration issues and evaluate their impact on deal timelines and functional readiness
* Develop structured, analytical, and compelling client deliverables and reports
* Support business development efforts including proposals, capability building, and client presentations
* Research and analyse market and company\-level technology insights to inform recommendations
* Collaborate closely with team members to ensure timely and quality outcomes


**What You’ll Bring**
* 2\+ years of experience in M\&A, consulting, or advisory roles within a large organisation
* Proven experience in operational or commercial due diligence; exposure to carve\-outs and integrations is a plus
* Familiarity with technology PMO or implementation within deal or transformation environments
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to extract insights and understand business drivers
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and collaboration tools such as Office 365
* Self\-starter with ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines
* Familiarity with digital and technology\-enabled solutions to enhance delivery

**Job Description**
 Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos.
   

  

 Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e\&), AT\&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.
   

  

 Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:
   

  

* Circles.Life: A wholly\-owned digital lifestyle telco brand based in Singapore, Circles.Life is powered by Circles’ SaaS platform and pioneering go\-to\-market strategies. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
* Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform\-as\-a\-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud\-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.
* Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year.


 Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a data\-savvy and detail\-oriented CVM Analyst to support the customer value management engine for our new digital telco brand in the MENA region. This role plays a key part in driving customer engagement, retention, and monetization by translating complex data into actionable insights, launching targeted lifecycle campaigns, and continuously optimizing performance across key CVM KPIs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings hands\-on experience in customer segmentation, campaign analytics, and lifecycle marketing, along with strong technical capabilities in SQL, Python / R, and BI tools.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Lifecycle campaign execution: Support the design, launch, and tracking of customer lifecycle campaigns across digital, contextual, and outbound channels, such as targeting acquisition, in\-life management, churn prevention, and reactivation
* CVM execution: Assist in the execution of data\-driven CVM strategies to increase ARPU and reduce churn by identifying up\-sell and cross\-sell opportunities through deep behavioral analysis
* Performance monitoring: Build and maintain campaign performance trackers for various lifecycle stages and monitor KPIs to flag deviations, trends, and anomalies
* Advanced analytics \& modeling: Partner with data teams to co\-develop churn prediction models, customer propensity models, and micro\-segmentation frameworks
* Channel optimization: Recommend the most efficient use of touchpoints by analyzing engagement rates across SMS, push, email, IVR, and digital placements
* Reporting \& insight generation: Leverage SQL, Python/R, and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik) to generate insight\-rich dashboards and campaign reports for internal stakeholders
* Data integration: Work with data engineering and IT teams to ensure timely availability and accuracy of data pipelines supporting campaign execution and performance measurement.

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Business, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (Python or R) is required
* Advanced skills in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik)
* Familiarity with CRM systems, campaign management platforms, and marketing automation tools
* Experience working with cloud\-based data ecosystems, ETL processes, and large\-scale data sets is preferred

data.jd_text:
**Job Requisition ID:** 
 175863
   

  

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day
   

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
* The Digital Delivery Lead is responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of digital initiatives in alignment with the digital transformation roadmap. The role demands expertise in digital product delivery, agile frameworks, and complex integrations to ensure programs are delivered on time, within budget, and meet expected business outcomes. The role encompasses managing Capex/OPEX, vendor budgets, and safeguarding business continuity. Success factors include achieving delivery velocity, stakeholder satisfaction index, and maintaining a low post\-release defect rate.


**What You Will Do:**
 Digital Transformation Execution
   

  

* Lead the delivery of digitalisation initiatives across onboarding, CRM, data, collections, and omni\-channel experience.
* Implement agile delivery models and manage cross\-functional teams to facilitate agile ceremonies and coaching.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects to ensure alignment with the target architecture and reduce system duplication.
* Ensure business\-as\-usual (BAU) continuity during transformation projects.
* Manage relationships with vendors and partners, ensuring adherence to service level agreements.
* Govern and report project progress through dashboards, maintaining deviation within 5% from the plan.
* Develop and mentor delivery teams, enhancing agile maturity and achieving skill certifications.


**Required Skills To Be Successful:**
* End\-to\-end agile delivery management.
* Cloud (Azure), integration (APIM/microservices), data, and AI enablement.
* Strong stakeholder communication and vendor governance.
* Ability to translate business strategies into executable plans.
* Experience in Core banking, fintech platforms, Full CRM suites and customer experience platforms


**What Equips You For The Role:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems.
* Certified Agile/Scrum Master or PMP\-Agile; SAFe certification preferred.
* 10\+ years in digital transformation and delivery, with at least 5 years in financial services.
* Experience in managing hybrid delivery teams and large multi\-system digital programs.
* Expertise in Azure DevOps/JIRA, CI/CD, and release management.


**About Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate**
 The real estate development and operations arm of Al\-Futtaim, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high\-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega\-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al\-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years.
   

  

 Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
   

  

 AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Malls**
 Al\-Futtaim Malls provides development and asset management expertise, specializing in building retail\-led super regional malls in prime locations across MENA and beyond. With a proven track record of creating both sustainable revenue growth and value enhancement for tenants, Al\-Futtaim Malls delivers exceptional experiences and exciting shopping environments for customers.
   

  

 Part of the Al\-Futtaim Group, Al\-Futtaim Malls leadership team brings more than 30 years of experience and a deep understanding and knowledge of the retail sector, both from a shopper’s point of view but as curators of space or landlords to other brands. The company has a directly managed portfolio including over 9 million sqft of retail space across four malls in the MENA region and two under development. Malls under the Al\-Futtaim Malls portfolio include Dubai Festival City Mall and Festival Plaza in the UAE, Cairo Festival City Mall in Egypt, Doha Festival City in Qatar and Zenata Mall, Morocco.
   

  

 Leveraging on the expertise of its parent company, Al\-Futtaim Malls established PLEX Management Services offering a full array of services including asset management and development, leasing, and brand experience expertise to shopping mall landlords and retail organizations globally. Implementing global best practice and deploying Al\-Futtaim Mall’s deep understanding of mall management and retail dynamics, PLEX promises to deliver continuous growth and long\-term value for its partners.
   

  

 For more information on Al\-Futtaim Malls, please visit https://www.al\-futtaimmalls.com/
   

  

**About Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies**
 Al\-Futtaim Engineering \& Technologies offers customers complete engineering and systems integration solutions.
   

  

 The Engineering arm operates in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Egypt providing a wide variety of products and services from air conditioning, scaffolding and access solutions, elevators and escalators, control and life safety, facilities management, building products, MEP, Energy Management, Technology Infrastructure and Digital Transformation.
   

  

 The Technologies division provides complete business solutions to large, medium and small customers that include, contact centre solutions, business applications, business intelligence, data management, advanced analytics amongst others. The IT infrastructure portfolio comprises IP telephony, ELV systems, networking solutions, professional audio\-visual solutions and managed services.
   

  

 These solutions are further complemented by services that include project management, installation, testing, commissioning and after\-sales maintenance contracts.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 Synechron is seeking an experienced AI Business Analyst with over 6 years of relevant experience to support the organization’s digital transformation initiatives. The role involves gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and technical requirements for AI\-driven solutions, particularly those involving Generative AI (GenAI) and Large Language Models (LLMs). The successful candidate will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring the delivery of AI solutions that meet strategic goals, deliver measurable ROI, and align with organizational standards. This role will contribute to advancing Synechron’s innovative AI capabilities and enhancing operational efficiency.
   

  

**Software Requirements**
* Required: Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Jira, Confluence, Visio, requirements management tools (e.g., IBM Engineering Lifecycle Management)
* Preferred: AI/ML model management tools, requirements traceability platforms, enterprise architecture tools
* Experience Level: Proficient with documentation and collaboration tools; comfortable working within AI/ML project environments


**Overall Responsibilities**
* Elicit, analyze, and document business needs, goals, and expected KPIs/ROI for AI projects
* Develop comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) outlining desired outcomes and success metrics
* Create Functional Specification Documents (FSDs) detailing functional and non\-functional requirements, reasoning flows, and integration points with existing systems
* Prepare detailed Use Case Narratives illustrating interactions between users, LLMs, and AI agents, including structured inputs, outputs, and workflows
* Map current workflows and conduct impact analysis, especially regarding the integration of GenAI/Agentic AI into operational processes
* Maintain Requirements Traceability Matrices to link business needs through architecture, testing, and acceptance phases
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure AI solutions align with business objectives and technical feasibility
* Facilitate communication between business units and technical teams to support delivery and change management
* Ensure requirement completeness, clarity, and adherence to organizational standards while supporting project timelines


**Technical Skills (By Category)**
* Programming Languages: Not typically required for this role, but understanding of Python, R, or similar languages is a plus (Preferred)
* Databases/Data Management: Basic familiarity with SQL, NoSQL databases, and data repositories used in AI projects (Preferred)
* Cloud Technologies: Experience with cloud platforms supporting AI development, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP (Preferred)
* Frameworks and Libraries: Knowledge of AI/ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.) is advantageous but not mandatory
* Development Tools and Methodologies: Agile/Scrum, requirements management tools, architecture modeling tools (Essential)
* Security Protocols: Awareness of data privacy, security, and compliance standards related to AI and data handling (Preferred)


**Experience Requirements**
* More than 6 years of business analysis experience in technology or AI\-driven projects
* Proven experience working on AI/ML projects, especially implementing GenAI or Large Language Models in business solutions
* Experience with end\-to\-end project lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and testing
* Familiarity with AI/ML industry standards, best practices, and related compliance policies
* Prior experience working in digital banking, finance, or telecom sectors is a plus but not mandatory


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Conduct stakeholder interviews to gather detailed business and technical requirements for AI initiatives
* Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and development teams to translate requirements into actionable specifications
* Create and maintain BRDs, FSDs, Use Case Narratives, RTMs, and impact analyses
* Lead workshops and review sessions to validate requirements and gather feedback
* Support testing and validation of AI solutions, ensuring compliance with business needs and KPIs
* Track project progress, evaluate deliverables, and adjust requirements as needed
* Support change management and facilitate communication between stakeholders and project teams
* Monitor AI solution performance post\-implementation to ensure alignment with expectations


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; Master’s degree preferred
* Certifications such as IIBA CBAP, CCBA, or related business analysis credentials preferred
* Continuous learning in AI/ML concepts, data management, and project management methodologies


**Professional Competencies**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address complex AI project requirements
* Effective communication skills to articulate technical details clearly to diverse audiences
* Ability to interpret and translate abstract AI concepts into clear, actionable requirements
* Collaborative mindset and stakeholder management expertise
* Organizational skills to handle multiple concurrent projects and changing priorities
* Critical thinking and adaptability for evolving AI landscape and organizational needs
* Commitment to quality, accuracy, and effective documentation practices.


***S***
***YNECHRON’S DIVERSITY \& INCLUSION STATEMENT***

data.jd_text:
Role Overview
 



  





 We are seeking a commercially driven and strategically minded Group CFO with deep experience in the telecommunications sector, a proven track record in IPO execution, and fluency in Tamil and English.
 



 The successful candidate will lead the Group’s financial strategy, capital markets activities, and operational finance functions, playing a critical role in scaling the business and delivering shareholder value.
 



  





 We will welcome applications from overseas providing you are willing to relocate to Dubai.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Strategic Leadership
 


* Partner with the CEO and Board to define and execute the Group’s long\-term financial strategy
* Provide strategic insight on growth initiatives, market expansion, and M\&A opportunities
* Act as a key advisor on capital structure, funding strategy, and investor positioning



 IPO \& Capital Markets
 


* Lead end\-to\-end IPO readiness and execution (governance, reporting, advisors, roadshow, listing)
* Manage relationships with investment banks, legal advisors, auditors, and regulators
* Oversee post\-listing compliance, investor relations, and market communications



 Financial Management
 


* Full ownership of Group financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting
* Ensure robust financial controls, risk management, and governance frameworks
* Drive performance management across all business units and geographies



 Telecom Sector Expertise
 


* Provide financial oversight of telecom operations including CAPEX\-intensive infrastructure, spectrum investments, and network rollout
* Monitor key telecom KPIs (ARPU, churn, EBITDA margins, subscriber growth, etc.)
* Support commercial teams with pricing, bundling, and market competitiveness analysis



 Operational Excellence
 


* Optimize cost structures and improve profitability across the Group
* Lead digital transformation within finance (systems, automation, analytics)
* Build and develop a high\-performing, internationally diverse finance team



 Stakeholder Management
 


* Present financial performance and strategy to Board, investors, and external stakeholders
* Act as a key interface with regulators across relevant jurisdictions
* Support corporate governance and ESG initiatives



  





 Key Requirements
 



  





 Experience \& Qualifications
 


* Proven experience as a CFO or senior finance leader in a telecommunications or related infrastructure business
* Demonstrated success in leading or playing a key role in an IPO (essential)
* Strong understanding of global capital markets, debt/equity financing, and investor relations
* Experience managing multi\-entity, multi\-country financial operations



 Technical Expertise
 


* Deep knowledge of IFRS / international accounting standards
* Strong financial modelling, valuation, and capital allocation skills
* Experience with large\-scale CAPEX planning and ROI analysis



 Language Skills
 


* Fluency in Tamil and English (spoken and written) — essential



 Leadership \& Personal Attributes
 


* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen
* High level of integrity, governance, and professionalism
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence at Board level
* Hands\-on, results\-oriented, and capable of operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment



 Preferred
 


* Experience in emerging markets or high\-growth telecom environments
* Prior exposure to private equity\-backed or pre\-IPO businesses
* International experience working across multiple jurisdictions

data.jd_text:
**Who we are** 




 GIG Gulf is part of the Gulf Insurance Group (GIG), the \#1 largest regional composite insurer in the Middle East and North Africa, with presence in 13 markets including the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Algeria, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, and Turkey. GIG Group reported consolidated assets of US$ 3\.83 billion and $69 million net profit for the year 2023\. The majority shareholder of GIG Group is Toronto based Fairfax Financial Holding, a global leader in insurance and reinsurance with a presence in 40 markets.
 



  





 GIG Gulf is an ‘A’ rated regional insurer with a top 5 position in each of its markets (UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain). GIG Gulf has been present in the region for over 70 years with a strategic focus on both growth and investments and is a one stop shop offering a wide range of insurance products and services that cater to a broad variety of needs for corporates, SMEs and individual customers throughout UAE, Oman, Bahrain, and Qatar. GIG Gulf also owns a 50% stake in GIG Saudi. Our strategic objectives and guiding principles are focused on Regional Growth, Customer Experience and Digital Transformation.
 



  





 GIG Gulf has created a diverse and inclusive working environment and culture with a workforce of over 800 employees, with over 60 nationalities, across 15 branches and retail shops region\-wide and over 1 million customers. GIG Gulf is a caring partner that encourages customers to achieve their goals and live an inspiring and fulfilling life. We are obsessed with customer feedback and continuously evolving to become the region’s digital insurer of reference, committed to running our operations in a responsible, sustainable way.
 



  





**Job purpose:** 




 The role will be versatile, covering different Business Lines and parts of the insurance value chain. The main mission will be to deploy strong technical expertise in both enhancing the data strategy and delivering solutions to business challenges.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be successful in this role not only through building on and developing subject matter expertise in Data Science techniques, but also through working closely and collaboratively with the business. This will be key to understand how to best identify domains where Data Science can help improve performance – and to develop solutions that are practical and adopted by the relevant business stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 





 Technical Development \& Data Solutions:
 



* Conduct exploratory data analysis on large, structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, correlations, and opportunities for performance improvement.
* Develop, validate, and refine mathematical and statistical models aligned with business needs.
* Apply data science techniques to real\-world use cases (e.g., customer segmentation, pricing optimization, network optimization, etc.).
* Design and implement innovative data science and Generative AI solutions (e.g., RAG pipelines, LLM\-based applications, agentic workflows) to address business challenges.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement and innovation of data science methodologies, tools, and approaches within the organization.



  






 Problem Framing \& Solution Design:
 



* Develop a deep understanding of business needs through close collaboration with stakeholders across functions (sales, product, etc.).

* Identify, evaluate, and select appropriate analytical methodologies, machine learning techniques, and solution architectures.
* Engage stakeholders to assess feasibility, relevance, and expected impact of proposed solutions.
* Ensure alignment and buy\-in at key stages of data science initiatives.



  






 Communication, Adoption \& Business Impact:
 



* Present and communicate analytical findings, models, and recommendations to business stakeholders and senior management.
* Translate complex technical outputs into clear, actionable insights for non\-technical audiences.
* Promote adoption of data\-driven solutions across the organization.
* Develop documentation, training materials, and deliver knowledge\-sharing sessions (e.g., demos).
* Contribute to fostering a data\-driven culture and continuous innovation within the organization.



  





**Operational \& Technical Responsibilities:** 



* Design, develop, and maintain end\-to\-end data science solutions, from data ingestion and processing to model deployment and monitoring.

 **cloud technologies** 
 (AWS: SageMaker, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Bedrock , … ; Azure: AI foundry, …) to support scalable analytics and machine learning use cases.

 , including CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, performance monitoring, and automated retraining.

 It ensures that learning solutions, platforms, and processes effectively support business performance, organizational transformation, and capability development at scale.
 



 The role acts as the center of excellence for learning innovation, establishing the standards, frameworks, governance, and technology\-enabled solutions that shape how learning is designed, deployed, and measured across MAGRABi.
 



 Working closely with senior stakeholders across HR, Retail, Clinical, and Business functions, the role translates organizational priorities into scalable learning strategies, capability frameworks, and high impact learning solutions that strengthen organizational performance and future readiness.
 



  





**Qualifications and Education:** 




  





 • Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Learning, Education, Psychology, Organizational Development, or a related field is required
 



 • Master’s degree is a plus

 • Knowledge of instructional design principles is beneficial, though deep hands\-on design expertise is not required.
