**Who we are** 




 GIG Gulf is part of the Gulf Insurance Group (GIG), the \#1 largest regional composite insurer in the Middle East and North Africa, with presence in 13 markets including the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Algeria, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon,
data.jd_text:
**Who we are** 




 GIG Gulf is part of the Gulf Insurance Group (GIG), the \#1 largest regional composite insurer in the Middle East and North Africa, with presence in 13 markets including the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Algeria, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, and Turkey. GIG Group reported consolidated assets of US$ 3\.83 billion and $69 million net profit for the year 2023\. The majority shareholder of GIG Group is Toronto based Fairfax Financial Holding, a global leader in insurance and reinsurance with a presence in 40 markets.
 



  





 GIG Gulf is an ‘A’ rated regional insurer with a top 5 position in each of its markets (UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain). GIG Gulf has been present in the region for over 70 years with a strategic focus on both growth and investments and is a one stop shop offering a wide range of insurance products and services that cater to a broad variety of needs for corporates, SMEs and individual customers throughout UAE, Oman, Bahrain, and Qatar. GIG Gulf also owns a 50% stake in GIG Saudi. Our strategic objectives and guiding principles are focused on Regional Growth, Customer Experience and Digital Transformation.
 



  





 GIG Gulf has created a diverse and inclusive working environment and culture with a workforce of over 800 employees, with over 60 nationalities, across 15 branches and retail shops region\-wide and over 1 million customers. GIG Gulf is a caring partner that encourages customers to achieve their goals and live an inspiring and fulfilling life. We are obsessed with customer feedback and continuously evolving to become the region’s digital insurer of reference, committed to running our operations in a responsible, sustainable way.
 



  





**Job purpose:** 




 The IT Service Desk Agent will be working as part of a team that is responsible for 1st line IT support for GIG Gulf staff. The role is based in GIG Gulf office in Bahrain Bay.
 



 The team works on answering, attending and resolving all the L1\.5 issues addressed to the IT Service Desk and escalates the rest to the appropriate teams in other levels as per standard procedures and agreements.
 



 The agent will be troubleshooting basic end\-user issues on various software applications, hardware, network and telecommunications systems and provide basic to advanced desktop support.
 



 The role requires excellent customer service, communication (written \+ verbal), and analytical skills.
 



  





**IT Service Desk Agent (Level 1\.5\) role summarized in 3 points:** 




  





 1\)Customer Service and Communication: Strong customer service and communication skills (written \+ verbal) to interact with users, explain technical concepts, actively listen, and provide timely and professional support.
 



 2\) Technical Proficiency: Strong foundation in operating systems, hardware, software applications, and network basics with the ability to diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues.
 



 3\) Problem\-solving and Analytical Skills: Effective problem\-solving, analysis of issues reported by users, identification of root causes, and implementation of appropriate solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Service Desk End\-User Support** 



* Manage end\-user issues raised to Service Desk (Level 1\.5\) through tickets and calls received through IVR
* Handle incoming calls from end\-users in a professional manner and within the defined service levels and ensure achievement of KPI’s
* Ensure proper and timely communication to the end\-user on every ticket through the Service Desk tool and phone
* Ensure all work conducted is being logged and managed within tickets raised by or on behalf of business users
* Provide high\-quality resolutions of assigned tickets and managing the expectations of the users
* Ensure to resolve and close all end\-user tickets within the defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) targets
* Escalate tickets that are beyond the scope of Service Desk to other teams in 2nd level (Applications team and Field Support team) and 3rd level (Infrastructure and Production teams)



  





**Operational \& Technical Responsibilities:** 




**Communication** 



* Act as the 1st point of contact for all IT related issues or requests
* Build a strong trust relationship with business users across the region
* Build strong collaboration with level 2 and 3 IT teams
* Create and update documentation for end\-users when needed for known issues/requests



**IT Support** 



* Create and modify user accounts for Active Directory and all applications
* Install end\-user software (licensing validity and availability checks)
* Deployment of new applications (and/or upgrades) and follow\-up
* Troubleshoot software application issues to resolve basic known ones and escalate complex ones to 2nd level, 3rd level and vendor
* Manage applications permissions changes for end\-users
* Create mailboxes/shared mailboxes / DL and troubleshoot email issues (Exchange Online/Office365\)
* Troubleshooting of printer issues
* Call center system support
* Mobile management enrollment and activation
* Shared folders permissions management



**Security** 



* Ensure full compliance with the Information Security policy and procedures
* Review encryption and antivirus definition status and remediate any issues
* Administrative Privileges management
* Ensure that all provided laptops have the necessary physical security measures
* Scan computers for virus infection
* Provide physical access to staff and visitors as necessary.



**Network and Telecom** 



* Troubleshoot end\-user internet issues
* Local area network and Ethernet connections support
* Wireless network access basic support
* Headset phone and softphone setup for call center staff
* VPN configuration and troubleshooting



  





**Essential Requirements:** 




**Communication and Soft Skills** 



* Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written
* Critical and analytical thinking and creativity – always challenging the status quo and find better ways to complete tasks
* Conflict Resolution – ability to resolve problems and complex situations
* Active listening and empathy – ability to listen and understand users to address their needs
* Team player – ability to work with a team and influence a positive collaborative culture
* Ability to prioritize workload appropriately based on the impact on the business



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Good understanding of computers architecture, Microsoft and desktop applications, computer peripherals, operating systems and application software
* Excellent understanding of Microsoft Windows infrastructure (Windows Server and Windows client)
* Good understanding of Microsoft Active Directory services , Azure AD, Microsoft M365 Admin portal
* Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office products including O365, Teams, Intune
* Familiarity with network architecture, LAN network protocols and client\-server business applications
* Familiarity with Citrix and remote desktop or any VDI platform
* Familiarity with Distributed File Sharing
* Excellent skills in Excel to prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly reports on Quality of Service \& Service Desk KPI reports for management submission.
* Good understanding of ITIL framework or any other service management framework
* Excellent understanding of IT service management tools and ticketing system
* Knowledge of using a call center system to manage incoming and outgoing calls with customers (Vocalcom, Cisco UC, Avaya etc.)
* Knowledge of using remote access tools for remote troubleshooting
* Ability to systematically troubleshoot complex problems and resolve them or escalate to the right team
* Proficient in utilizing Microsoft Excel for generating reports related to service desk activities.
* Skilled in extracting and analyzing service desk data to identify trends, patterns, and performance metrics



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor or Diploma Degree in an IT related field or equivalent hands\-on experience
* 5\+ years’ experience in an IT Service Desk role
* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation Certification
* MCSA in Windows Server 2012/2016 or MCTS in Windows Server 2008

Position Overview
 



 The VP of HSQA is responsible for leading and overseeing the organization's occupational health, safety, quality assurance, and compliance programs. This role ensures that all HSQA systems meet legal, regulatory, and international standards, while partnering with senior leadership and operational teams to build a strong, proactive safety and quality culture across all sites.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and implement HSQA strategies aligned with company goals.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, compliance, and quality across all levels.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including digital transformation of HSQA processes.
* Ensure implementation and maintenance of ISO certifications (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, etc.).
* Oversee programs that enhance employee engagement in health, safety, and quality.
* Recruit, develop, and lead HSQA professionals to support organizational excellence.
* Monitor, measure, and report HSQA performance to senior leadership.
* Lead risk assessments, incident investigations, and compliance reviews.
* Facilitate safety committees and drive stakeholder compliance activities.



  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Health Sciences, Safety, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* CMIOSH or equivalent recognized HSQA certification.
* NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent.
* Lead Auditor certifications in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 (additional ISO standards are an advantage).
* Minimum 20 years of total HSQA experience.
* At least 8 years of experience working within shipyards (mandatory).
* Strong background in maritime, shipyard, or oil \& gas HSQA environments.
* Proven leadership experience in senior HSQA roles.
* Extensive knowledge of risk management, hazard identification, and incident investigation techniques.



  





 Key Competencies
 


* Strong understanding of HSQA systems, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent analytical, decision\-making, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to influence, engage, and promote a strong safety and quality culture.
* Strong communication, leadership, and team development skills.
* High attention to detail and strong organizational ability.

**About us** 




 EPAM Systems is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and software development services. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Newtown, Pennsylvania, EPAM has been helping clients navigate digital transformation for over 30 years, delivering innovative solutions to stay competitive in constantly evolving markets.
 



 As consultants, designers, architects, engineers and trainers, at EPAM, we specialize in building long\-term partnerships, enabling businesses to reimagine themselves through a digital lens. In Saudi Arabia, EPAM operates in Riyadh and Al Khobar, offering cutting\-edge engineering, strategy, design, consulting, and innovation services across industries.
 



  
 



  
 



 We are looking for a
 **Senior Frontend Developer with strong experience in JavaScript** 
 and modern frameworks (React and/or Angular) to join our team in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. EPAM is renowned for delivering cutting\-edge technological solutions to transform businesses worldwide.
 



 You will be responsible for building responsive, user\-friendly interfaces, collaborating closely with designers, backend engineers and product owners to deliver high\-quality web applications.
 



 The deadline for submission is
 **31/05/2026** 




  
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Develop, maintain and optimize user\-facing features using JavaScript, React and/or Angular
* Implement clean, modular and reusable UI components following best practices and design guidelines
* Work with designers to translate UI/UX prototypes into functional, pixel\-accurate interfaces
* Integrate frontend components with RESTful APIs and backend services
* Ensure cross\-browser, cross\-device and cross\-platform compatibility
* Optimize applications for performance, accessibility and SEO (where applicable)
* Write and maintain unit tests and/or integration tests to ensure code quality and reliability
* Participate in code reviews, provide feedback and maintain high engineering standards
* Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and propose technical solutions
* Contribute to frontend architecture, tooling and development processes (linting, build pipelines, CI/CD etc.)







**Requirements** 



* 5\+ years of professional experience as a Frontend Engineer/Frontend Developer
* Valid SCE (Saudi Council of Engineers) certificate (or eligibility to obtain) is required for this position
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and web fundamentals: HTML5, CSS3
* Hands\-on experience with React and/or Angular in production projects
* Familiarity with state management (e.g., Redux, NgRx, Context API or similar)
* Experience with responsive and adaptive design, including grid systems and media queries
* Understanding of RESTful APIs and client–server communication
* Experience with frontend build tools and package managers (Webpack, Vite, npm, Yarn etc.)
* Knowledge of version control systems, especially Git
* Basic understanding of testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, Jasmine, Karma etc.)

* Applies data modeling and competitive analysis frameworks to identify and evaluate key competitors and industry benchmarks, informing strategic positioning and program development
* Develops and refines performance indicators to measure program effectiveness, impact, and key performance metrics
* Generates actionable insights and prepares comprehensive analytical reports using visualization tools to support evidence\-based decision\-making across the department
* Assists in evaluating the social and cultural impact of the Center's programs and initiatives by analyzing quantitative and qualitative data sets
* Collaborates with internal stakeholders to extract, process, and interpret data, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and digital transformation strategies
* Designs and maintains interactive dashboards, presentations, and data summaries for management review and strategic discussion


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in data management, information technology, business administration, Research, Economics, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Minimum of 3\-year Experience in research, data analysis, and strategic planning, preferably in a cultural sector environment
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable insights
* Familiarity with performance measurement tools and key performance indicator (KPI) development
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to diverse audiences
* Proficiency in using data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, or similar platforms)


 Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and manage multiple priorities effectively.

Faculty in Industrial Engineering
   

  

 Artificial Intelligence, Digital Systems, and Industrial Analytics
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Department of Industrial Engineering invites applications for a faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Professor from outstanding candidates with expertise at the intersection of Industrial Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, software\-driven systems, optimization, and data analytics. We seek a highly qualified and forward\-looking academic who can contribute to teaching, research, graduate supervision, and industry collaboration, while helping shape a modern Industrial Engineering department aligned with Industry 4\.0, smart systems, digital transformation, and applied research excellence. The candidate is expected to have an exceptional track record in artificial intelligence and machine learning, including demonstrated expertise in large language models and robotics\-oriented applications. The successful candidate is expected to develop an exceptional teaching and research portfolio that strengthens the department’s undergraduate and postgraduate offerings, with a particular role in supporting and expanding the MSc programs through advanced teaching, thesis supervision, interdisciplinary research, and curriculum innovation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to:
   

  

* Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in Industrial Engineering and related areas.
* Develop and deliver advanced courses in areas such as:
+ Artificial Intelligence for Engineering Systems
+ Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics
+ Optimization and Decision Support Systems
+ Simulation Modeling and Digital Twins
+ Operations Research and Intelligent Systems
+ Industrial Software Applications and Data\-Driven Decision Making
+ Smart Manufacturing and Industry 4\.0

* Supervise MSc students and contribute actively to graduate research, thesis development, and program growth.
* Establish a strong, externally visible research agenda leading to high\-impact publications, funded projects, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
* Integrate AI and software tools into Industrial Engineering education, research, and real\-world applications.
* Contribute to curriculum development, accreditation, quality assurance, and continuous program improvement.
* Participate in departmental, college, and university service activities.
* Support the development of research labs, graduate pathways, and innovation initiatives that position the department as a regional and international leader.


**Required Qualifications**
 Candidates must have:
   

  

* A PhD in Industrial Engineering or a closely related field from a recognized and reputable institution.
* Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas:
+ Artificial Intelligence
+ Machine Learning
+ Optimization
+ Data Analytics
+ Industrial Software Systems
+ Smart Manufacturing
+ Simulation and Modeling
+ Operations Research

* Evidence of strong teaching capability at the university level.
* A record of scholarly achievement appropriate to rank, including publications in reputable peer\-reviewed journals.
* The ability to contribute to curriculum development and interdisciplinary academic initiatives.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and academic leadership skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 Preference will be given to candidates with:
   

  

* An established research profile in AI\-enabled Engineering applications.
* Experience in developing or teaching courses that combine engineering, software, and analytics.
* Experience supervising graduate students, especially at the MSc or PhD level.
* A track record of securing competitive research funding.
* Industry or applied research experience in areas such as manufacturing systems, logistics, healthcare systems, supply chain analytics, digital transformation, or smart operations.
* Experience building collaborations with research centers, government entities, and industry partners.
* Professional proficiency in programming, computational tools, or industrial software platforms such as Python, R, MATLAB, CPLEX, Gurobi, AnyLogic, Arena, Power BI, SQL, or related systems.


 About American International University:
   

  

 AIU is a new institution of higher education in Kuwait whose first student cohort was admitted in fall 2019\. It is a private, co\-educational institution offering undergraduate degrees based on the American model of higher education, including a comprehensive general education curriculum. Through its educational and student services programming, the University serves the intellectual, cultural, and personal growth of all members of its community. AIU offers degree programs in Engineering, Architecture, and Design, and Business Administration where the language of instruction is English.
   

  

 For more information about AIU visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
   

  

 How to apply:
   

  

 To apply for this position, please visit the Job Opportunities section of our webpage and submit your resume and cover letter: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs

**Role –** 
 Lead Consultant
 



**Technology** 
 – ERP Finance Fusion Consultant
 



**Location** 
 – Muscat, Oman
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





 We are seeking a highly experienced Oracle Fusion Finance Lead/Principal Consultant to oversee and drive end‑to‑end implementation and support of key Fusion Financials modules, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), Expense Management, Tax, Revenue Management Cloud Services (RMCS), Projects and Advanced Collections. The consultant will work closely with Finance leadership, business SMEs, and cross‑functional teams to define solution architecture, lead workshops, guide functional consultants, ensure seamless module integration, and provide expert oversight for project execution. This role requires strong command over financial processes, statutory and compliance requirements, and the ability to independently lead discussions with the customer.
 



  





**Your role** 




  





 In the role of a Lead or Principal consultant, you will serve to facilitate Finance Functional role with below responsibilities as followed.
 


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of Oracle Fusion Finance modules: GL, AP, AR, FA, CM, Expense Management, Tax, Revenue Management Cloud Services (RMCS), Projects and Advanced Collections (if applicable).
* Conduct requirements workshops with customer business users and senior office, Finance Controllers, AP/AR teams, Treasury, and Audit teams.
* Translate business processes into future\-state Fusion Finance architecture.
* Prepare solution designs, BRDs/MD50s, test scripts, and configuration documents



  





  





**Responsibilities** 



* **Module Configuration \& Functional Expertise**
* Configure Fusion Financial modules based on global design principles and local statutory needs.
* Manage Chart of Accounts (CoA), ledgers, legal entities, accounting rules, subledger configurations, and tax setups.
* Support period close processes, reconciliations, journals, allocations, and intercompany flows.
* Drive setup for bank accounts, cash pooling, payment formats, and treasury workflows.
* **Finance Integrations \& Reporting**
* Provide functional leadership for integrations with Payroll, Procurement \& SCM, Treasury systems, Banking interfaces, and third\-party invoicing platforms.
* Collaborate with technical teams on FBDI/HDL\-based loads, OIC/REST API integrations, and OTBI/BI Publisher reports.
* Lead financial data validation, reconciliation, and cutover activities.
* **Project Governance \& Customer Engagement**
* Independently handle client discussions, workshops, and solution walkthroughs.
* Partner with PMO on planning, RAIDs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and status reporting.
* Manage functional consultants working across different finance modules.
* Ensure compliance with audit, internal controls, and statutory requirements.
* **Testing, Rollout \& Support**
* Lead SIT, UAT, regression testing, and hypercare support.
* Drive quarter\-end and year\-end support readiness.
* Own issue triaging, resolution management, and continuous improvements.
* Guide business users on new features and quarterly Fusion Cloud updates.
* **Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10–15 years of experience in Oracle ERP implementations; 6\+ years in Oracle Fusion Cloud.
* Strong expertise in at least 4–5 Finance modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, CM, Taxes, Revenue Management Cloud Services (RMCS), Projects, Expenses).
* Deep knowledge of Subledger Accounting (SLA), multi\-ledger architecture, and cross\-module flows.
* Hands\-on experience in finance data migration (FBDI uploads, opening balances, historical data, EBS to Cloud).
* Experience with Oracle Cloud implementation methodologies
* Experience in Telecommunications sector
* Strong understanding of statutory reporting, localization, and period close processes.
* Ability to lead functional teams and coordinate with technical architects.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Preferred** 




  




* Should be excellent planner when it comes to perform release planning and other delivery planning.
* Should have excellent problem\-solving skills
* Experience in GCC/Middle East finance regulatory environments.
* Exposure to enterprise multi\-company, multi\-country rollouts.
* Familiarity with integrations involving banks, treasury systems, and procurement.
* Experience in onsite–offshore delivery models.



  





**Personal** 




  





 Besides the professional qualifications of the candidates, we place great importance in addition to various forms personality profile. These include:
 


* Strong analytical ability and business acumen.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and consulting presence.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* High accountability and delivery focus.



  





**Why Infosys** 




  





 Infosys is a global leader in next\-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation.
 



 With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI\-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always\-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
 



  





 “All aspects of employment at Infosys are based on merit, competence and performance. We are committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Infosys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.”

We are recruiting a Senior Backend Architect (Real\-Time Systems) for one of our clients, a well\-known information technology company based in Muscat, Oman.

 Our client is a leading information technology company based in Muscat, Oman, known for delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions across various industries. * Define data models and streaming topologies
* Create blueprints for stateful stream processing
* Architect for deterministic low latency (\<50ms p99\) by optimizing garbage collection, lock\-free data structures, and CPU caching behavior
* Design data partitioning and replication strategies for both hot and warm storage
* Set coding standards for non\-blocking I/O
* Lead architectural reviews to ensure real\-time SLAs are met under peak load
* Create runbooks for real\-time debugging (async stack traces, latency flame graphs)

* Proven experience building or leading high\-concurrency, low\-latency systems
* Strong understanding of concurrency, race conditions, atomic operations, consistency, idempotency, and fault tolerance
* Experience with real\-time or event\-driven systems
* Experience designing systems where response time under load is critical
* Strong backend development experience in Golang and Python
* Experience with caching, in\-memory data stores, relational databases, APIs, queues, and event\-driven architecture
* Experience with WebSocket or similar real\-time communication mechanisms
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, orchestration, and production\-grade backend deployment
* Ability to stay hands\-on technically while also leading engineers and making architectural decisions



  




**Strongly Preferred:**
* Experience measuring and optimizing latency under load

* Experience with production monitoring, bottleneck analysis, and incident handling

**Preferred Backgrounds:**
 Candidates with experience in the following types of platforms will be preferred:
   

* Betting/Sportsbook

* Ride dispatch/Allocation Systems

 To lead and oversee Asset Integrity across OQEP operated assets, ensuring the safe, reliable, and compliant operation of facilities and pipelines. The role owns asset integrity standards and inspection governance, addressing complex technical issues across core engineering disciplines to sustain mechanical availability and operational continuity. Through the development and execution of robust inspection, corrosion, and materials, frameworks aligned with international industry standards, the position safeguards static equipment, piping, and pipelines integrity. The role ensures risk\-based decision\-making, regulatory compliance, and technical assurance to protect people, environment, and asset value—ultimately supporting operational excellence, asset longevity, and sustainable business performance for OQEP.
 



 The position will act in accordance with the OQEP’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, QHSE \& Energy Management System requirements standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
 



**Main tasks and responsibilities** 




  




* Ensure systematic and timely inspections and recommendations to maximize static equipment \& piping mechanical availability
* Identify and implement specialized inspection programs to minimize intrusive inspections and maximize equipment mechanical availability
* Coordinate with technical services and project delivery departments to provide input based on observations from failures for continuous improvement and design specifications
* Monitoring of individual performance and KPI’s for timely update and feedback to team members and management.
* Developing staff development plan and coaching programs
* Leading and advance digital transformation initiatives for Asset Integrity and corrosion
* Ensure a safe working environment in compliance with all company and governmental rules and regulations



  





**Integrity (Wells Integrity, Static Integrity, Pipeline Integrity)** 



* Execute all necessary asset integrity management related activities to ensure timely integrity support for maintenance, external contractors, operation, planning and others as appropriate
* Ensure establishment and implementation (RBI) Risk Based Inspection programs and plans which ensure focused and optimized inspections in order to optimize inspection and maintenance costs through a focused process and system
* Oversee the Inspection, analysis \& recommendations maximizing interval between intrusive inspections equipment,
* Ensure the inspection contains the highest standards as per procedures, specifications, applicable and codes
* Oversee and ensure compliance to WIMS (Well Integrity Management System) guidelines/ system for the well life cycle for OQEP.
* To supervise well problems related to integrity, recommend cost\-effective investigative and/or corrective measures
* Reviewing the compliance to the WIMS standards in all fields and recommending areas of improvement to enhance compliance
* To supervise Well Integrity Testing (WIT) \& Subsurface Integrity Testing (SIT) maintenance \& testing plans as per OQEP requirements and follow up on actions.
* To develop \& implement well integrity KPI
* Budget estimation for all integrity aspects of wells, pipelines, and static.
* Support and supervise recommendation of major repairs to fixed equipment and piping.
* Ensure maintaining auditable record system of inspection and inspection results



  





**Corrosion \& Material Selection** 



* Ensure procedures and systems in place for systematic failure analysis to achieve reduced repeat failures and defect elimination
* Provide technical support and guidance regarding the cost\-effective selection of materials, corrosion mitigation, corrosion monitoring strategies to ensure the technical integrity of the materials applied in subsurface and surface hydrocarbon production, processing and transportation systems throughout their design life.
* Review corrosion monitoring programs to identify and recommend timely actions to improve mechanical availability.
* Overseeing corrosion monitoring and control programs and systems to ensure plant and equipment meet the required company standards, applicable codes of practice department strategies and company policy.
* Lead the technical interaction with different department on subject related to Materials and Corrosion. Expertise on various materials, like CS, SS, DSS and non\-metallics like RTP and GRP.
* Establish systems and procedures to ensure internal project QA/QC related to Materials, Corrosion, and Integrity to minimize failures due to poor quality.
* Monitor and improve the quality of Materials, Corrosion, and Integrity including the design of quality standards, inspection of materials, equipment, processes and develop quality Control system with corrective actions;
